## Account

### ensure

`account.ensure`

Creates an X Developer Platform account for the authenticated user if they do not already have one, and returns it. Idempotent: when the user already has an account it is returned unchanged with `created` false. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope developer.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.account.ensure({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `metadata` | `string` | No | Optional provisioning-credit metadata (an opaque string, e.g. a subscription tier) to claim for the account, attributed to the calling app. Omit to just ensure the account. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
  account_id?: string | null,
  created?: boolean | null
} | null
```
</Accordion>

### get

`account.get`

Returns the X Developer Platform account that is billed for the authenticated user's API access. A user with no such account gets a resource-not-found error entry. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope developer.read (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.account.get({});
```

**Input:** _empty object_


**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
  account_id?: string | null,
  created_at?: string | null,
  name?: string | null
} | null
```
</Accordion>

## Account Activity

### subscriptions.count

`accountActivity.subscriptions.count`

Retrieves a count of currently active Account Activity subscriptions. Needs app-only auth: X accepts only the app's Bearer token here (connect with authType 'api_key').

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.accountActivity.subscriptions.count({});
```

**Input:** _empty object_


**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
  account_name?: string | null,
  provisioned_count?: string | null,
  subscriptions_count_all?: string | null,
  subscriptions_count_direct_messages?: string | null
} | null
```
</Accordion>

### subscriptions.validate

`accountActivity.subscriptions.validate`

Checks a user's Account Activity subscription for a given webhook. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.accountActivity.subscriptions.validate({ webhook_id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

## Activity

### subscriptions.create

`activity.subscriptions.create`

Creates a subscription for an X activity event. OAuth2 user-context tokens must hold the scope matching the requested event_type: dm.read for chat.* and dm.* events, like.read for like.* events, mute.read for mute.* events, block.read for block.* events, follows.read for subscriptions.* events, and tweet.read for all other event types.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.activity.subscriptions.create({
	event_type: 'profile.update.bio',
	filter: {},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `event_type` | `profile.update.bio \| profile.update.profile_picture \| profile.update.banner_picture \| profile.update.screenname \| profile.update.geo \| profile.update.url \| profile.update.verified_badge \| profile.update.affiliate_badge \| profile.update.handle \| trends.new \| news.new \| follow.follow \| follow.unfollow \| subscriptions.subscribe \| subscriptions.unsubscribe \| spaces.start \| spaces.end \| broadcast.start \| broadcast.end \| broadcast.chat \| broadcast.chat.remove \| chat.received \| chat.sent \| chat.conversation.join \| chat.conversation_join \| chat.conversation.member_added \| chat.conversation.member_removed \| chat.conversation.admin_added \| chat.conversation.admin_removed \| chat.update.group_name \| chat.update.restrictions \| dm.sent \| dm.received \| dm.indicate_typing \| dm.read \| post.create \| post.delete \| post.mention.create \| post.reply.create \| post.quote.create \| post.repost.create \| like.create \| mute.mute \| mute.unmute \| block.block \| block.unblock` | Yes | Activity event type in dot notation. `chat.conversation_join` is a deprecated alias of `chat.conversation.join`; responses always use the canonical name. |
| `expires_at` | `string` | No | Optional RFC 3339 expiration time. Re-creating the same subscription refreshes this value; omitting it makes the subscription permanent. |
| `filter` | `object` | Yes | — |
| `tag` | `string` | No | Optional caller-defined tag. |
| `webhook_id` | `string` | No | Webhook to deliver the subscription events to. |

```ts
	ids: ['1460323737035677698'],
});
```

### subscriptions.list

## Articles

### createDraft

`articles.createDraft`

Creates a new Article draft that can later be published. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.articles.createDraft({
	title: 'Launch week',
	content_state: {
		blocks: [{ text: 'Shipping the new release today.', type: 'unstyled' }],
		entities: [{
			key: '1460323737035677698',
			value: {
				type: 'post',
				mutability: 'immutable',
				data: {},
			},
		}],
	},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `content_state` | `object` | Yes | — |
| `cover_media` | `object` | No | — |
| `title` | `string` | Yes | The title of the Article. |

## Bots

### create

`bots.create`

Creates a bot account in the calling app's project and returns its bearer token. Idempotent on handle: repeating the request for a handle that already names one of the project's bots returns that bot with a freshly minted token, revoking the previous one — safe to retry when a response was lost, since the replaced token was never seen.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.bots.create({ handle: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `display_name` | `string` | No | The bot's display name; defaults to the handle. |
| `handle` | `string` | Yes | The bot's handle (X screen name): 5-15 characters, letters, numbers, or underscores. |
| `org_only` | `boolean` | No | Whether only members of the bot's developer account can add it to group chats. An org-only bot has no public profile and doesn't appear in public search. Everyone in its developer account should be able to message it, so leave its Direct Messages open to everyone rather than premium senders only. Defaults to false. Applies only when the request creates the bot: a handle that already names one of the project's bots keeps that bot's setting, which the response's org_only reports. |
| `scopes` | `string[]` | No | Scopes for the bot's bearer token. Broadcast moderation additionally supports broadcast.read and broadcast.write. Defaults to the XChat scope set (dm.read, dm.write, tweet.read, users.read, media.write). |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### delete

`bots.delete`

Deletes a bot account from the calling app's project. With an OAuth 2.0 user token, the user must be an admin of the project's developer account. On API Connect, where the request bills the user's own account, the bot is deleted from the user's project instead.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.bots.delete({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

---

### list

`bots.list`

Retrieves the bot accounts in the calling app's project. meta.max_bots is the most bots the project can have. Needs app-only auth: X accepts only the app's Bearer token here (connect with authType 'api_key').

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.bots.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(affiliation \| most_recent_post_id \| pinned_post_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### token.revoke

`bots.token.revoke`

Revokes a bot's bearer token. The bot account is kept, and rotating its token mints a new one. Needs app-only auth: X accepts only the app's Bearer token here (connect with authType 'api_key').

### token.rotate

`bots.token.rotate`

Mints a new bearer token for a bot and invalidates every token previously issued for it. The new token is returned only once.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.bots.token.rotate({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `scopes` | `string[]` | No | Scopes for the new bearer token. Broadcast moderation additionally supports broadcast.read and broadcast.write. Defaults to the XChat scope set (dm.read, dm.write, tweet.read, users.read, media.write). |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### update

`bots.update`

Updates a bot's handle, display name, or who may send it Direct Messages. Needs app-only auth: X accepts only the app's Bearer token here (connect with authType 'api_key').

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.bots.update({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `display_name` | `string` | No | New display name. |
| `dm_permission` | `everyone \| premium \| no_one` | No | Who may send the bot Direct Messages: everyone, or premium for verified senders only. Premium isn't meant for org-only bots, since everyone in an org-only bot's developer account should be able to message it, verified or not; requesting premium for one may be refused with a 400. The no_one value is deprecated and kept only so bots that already use it can keep it; choosing it for any other bot may be refused with a 400. |
| `handle` | `string` | No | New handle (X screen name): 5-15 characters, letters, numbers, or underscores. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

```ts
} | null
```

## Broadcasts

### chat.deleteMessage

`broadcasts.chat.deleteMessage`

Removes a specific chat message from a running broadcast where the authenticated user is the host or a moderator. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read, broadcast.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.broadcasts.chat.deleteMessage({ id: '1460323737035677698', message_id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `message_id` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### chat.list

`broadcasts.chat.list`

Returns newest-first chat messages for a broadcast owned by the authenticated user. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.broadcasts.chat.list({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A 64-bit signed integer. |
| `broadcast_chat_message.fields` | `(author_name \| author_username \| broadcast_id \| created_at_ms \| id \| relay_source \| relay_user \| reply_to \| text)[]` | No | A comma separated list of BroadcastChatMessage fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `author_id[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### chat.muteUser

`broadcasts.chat.muteUser`

Prevents a user from posting further messages in a running broadcast chat. When `end_at_ms` is provided, the mute expires at that time. The authenticated user must be the broadcast host or a moderator. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read, broadcast.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.broadcasts.chat.muteUser({ id: '1460323737035677698', user_id: '2244994945' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `end_at_ms` | `string` | No | The Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the mute expires. Omit this field to mute indefinitely. |
| `message_id` | `string` | No | A chat message to remove while muting the user. |
| `user_id` | `string` | Yes | The user to mute. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### chat.send

`broadcasts.chat.send`

Posts a chat message to a running broadcast, attributed to the authenticated user. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read, broadcast.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.broadcasts.chat.send({ id: '1460323737035677698', text: 'Shipping the new release today.' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `relay_source` | `string` | No | The platform this message was relayed from, shown as that platform's icon next to the message: `youtube`, `twitch`, `kick`, `facebook`, `rumble`, `tiktok` or `instagram`. Only apps approved for chat relay may set it. |
| `relay_user` | `string` | No | The name of the person who wrote this message on the platform it was relayed from, shown next to that platform's icon. Display text only, not an X account. Requires `relay_source`. Links are not allowed. |
| `reply_to` | `string` | No | Message id to reply to, returned as timestamp when sent. |
| `text` | `string` | Yes | The chat message text. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### chat.unmuteUser

`broadcasts.chat.unmuteUser`

Allows a muted user to post messages in a running broadcast chat again. The authenticated user must be the broadcast host or a moderator. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read, broadcast.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.broadcasts.chat.unmuteUser({ id: '1460323737035677698', user_id: '2244994945' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `user_id` | `string` | Yes | A 64-bit signed integer. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### chatModerators.add

`broadcasts.chatModerators.add`

Adds a moderator to the authenticated broadcaster's persistent list and returns the updated moderator user IDs. The list applies to all current and future broadcast chats. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read, broadcast.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.broadcasts.chatModerators.add({ user_id: '2244994945' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `user_id` | `string` | Yes | The user to appoint as a moderator. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

---

### chatModerators.list

`broadcasts.chatModerators.list`

Returns the authenticated broadcaster's persistent moderators as User resources. The list applies to all of their current and future broadcast chats. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.broadcasts.chatModerators.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(affiliation \| most_recent_post_id \| pinned_post_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### chatMutes.create

`broadcasts.chatMutes.create`

Prevents a user from posting messages in all of a broadcaster's chats. Without `broadcast_id`, the user is muted in the authenticated user's own chats. Moderators pass `broadcast_id` to mute the user in that broadcast host's chats. When `end_at_ms` is provided, the mute expires at that time. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read, broadcast.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.broadcasts.chatMutes.create({ user_id: '2244994945' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `broadcast_id` | `string` | No | A broadcast whose host's chats the user is muted in. Required with `message_id`. |
| `end_at_ms` | `string` | No | The Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the mute expires. Omit this field to mute indefinitely. |
| `message_id` | `string` | No | A chat message in `broadcast_id` to remove while muting the user. |
| `user_id` | `string` | Yes | The user to mute. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>

```ts
  muted?: boolean | null
} | null
```

---

### chatMutes.list

`broadcasts.chatMutes.list`

Returns the users muted in the authenticated broadcaster's chat, with the expiry time of timed mutes. Mutes apply to all of their broadcasts. Expired timed mutes are omitted. Use `expansions=user_id` to include the muted users. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.broadcasts.chatMutes.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | — |
| `broadcast_chat_mute.fields` | `end_at_ms[]` | No | A comma separated list of BroadcastChatMute fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `user_id[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### create

`broadcasts.create`

Takes one or more of the authenticated user's sources live and returns 201 with the new broadcast. Several sources (`source_id` plus `additional_source_ids`, one per video format) go live together as one broadcast; they must all be RTMP sources in one region, and when one of them is already live its broadcast is returned only if it holds every listed source. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read, broadcast.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.broadcasts.create({ source_id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `additional_source_ids` | `string[]` | No | Ids of further sources to go live on together with `source_id`, one per video format, at most 2, each a source's `id` from GET /2/sources. `source_id` comes first; duplicates are ignored. |
| `chat_option` | `number` | No | Who can chat: 0 default, 1 chat off, 2 everyone, 3 verified accounts, 4 accounts the host follows, 5 the host's subscribers, 6 accounts followed by an account the host follows. |
| `live_category_id` | `string` | No | The live category the host picked, e.g. `gaming`. Ids come from GET /2/broadcasts/categories; an unknown id is a 400. Ignored when the source already has a live broadcast. |
| `locale` | `string` | No | Broadcast language, e.g. `en`. |
| `should_not_tweet` | `boolean` | No | Skip the Post announcing the broadcast. Defaults to false. |
| `source_id` | `string` | Yes | Id of the source to go live on: a source's `id` (19 digits) from GET /2/sources. |
| `title` | `string` | No | Broadcast title. Defaults to the user's display name. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### end

`broadcasts.end`

Ends one of the authenticated user's broadcasts. Only `state: END` is supported. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read, broadcast.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.broadcasts.end({ id: '1460323737035677698', state: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `chat_option` | `number` | No | Not allowed with `END`. |
| `locale` | `string` | No | Not allowed with `END`. |
| `should_not_tweet` | `boolean` | No | Not allowed with `END`. |
| `state` | `string` | Yes | `END`. `PUBLISH` is not supported. |
| `title` | `string` | No | Not allowed with `END`. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### get

`broadcasts.get`

Returns a broadcast owned by the authenticated user. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.broadcasts.get({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `broadcast.fields` | `(available_for_replay \| broadcast_id \| chat_option \| created_at_ms \| end_ms \| height \| id \| image_url \| image_url_medium \| image_url_small \| is_high_latency \| language \| live_category_id \| media_key \| scheduled_end_ms \| scheduled_start_ms \| share_url \| source_id \| start_ms \| state \| title \| total_watched \| total_watching \| tweet_id \| twitter_user_id \| updated_at_ms \| width)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Broadcast fields to display. |

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### list

`broadcasts.list`

Returns the authenticated user's live-video broadcasts, or selected owned broadcasts when ids are provided. At most one of `ids`, `max_results` may be provided. At most one of `ids`, `pagination_token` may be provided. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.broadcasts.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ids` | `string[]` | No | Comma-separated broadcast IDs to retrieve instead of listing broadcasts. |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | — |
| `broadcast.fields` | `(available_for_replay \| broadcast_id \| chat_option \| created_at_ms \| end_ms \| height \| id \| image_url \| image_url_medium \| image_url_small \| is_high_latency \| language \| live_category_id \| media_key \| scheduled_end_ms \| scheduled_start_ms \| share_url \| source_id \| start_ms \| state \| title \| total_watched \| total_watching \| tweet_id \| twitter_user_id \| updated_at_ms \| width)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Broadcast fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### listCategories

`broadcasts.listCategories`

Returns the live categories a host can pick when going live, in display order. Pass a category's `id` as `live_category_id` on POST /2/broadcasts. Ids are permanent; names can change, so store the id and show the current name. The whole list is returned in one response, without paging. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.broadcasts.listCategories({});
```

| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### scheduled.create

`broadcasts.scheduled.create`

Schedules a broadcast for the authenticated user on one of their sources: `source_id` is required. Passing a stream key as `source_id` is deprecated and stops working when the /2/users/:id/sources and /2/users/:id/broadcasts routes reach end of life on January 1, 2027; pass the source's `id` from GET /2/sources instead. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read, broadcast.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.broadcasts.scheduled.create({ source_id: '1460323737035677698', scheduled_start_ms: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `available_for_replay` | `boolean` | No | Enable replay. |
| `chat_option` | `string` | No | Who can chat (numeric string): `0` default, `1` chat off, `2` everyone, `3` verified accounts, `4` accounts the host follows, `5` the host's subscribers, `6` accounts followed by an account the host follows. |
| `description` | `string` | No | Description. |
| `is_locked` | `boolean` | No | Lock the broadcast. |
| `locale` | `string` | No | Locale. |
| `manual_publish` | `boolean` | No | If true, do not auto-publish at start; call POST .../live when ready. |
| `recurrence` | `object` | No | — |
| `scheduled_end_ms` | `string` | No | Optional end time, ms since Unix epoch (decimal string). Omit for an open-ended broadcast. |
| `scheduled_start_ms` | `string` | Yes | Start time, ms since Unix epoch (decimal string). |
| `source_id` | `string` | Yes | Source to bind: a source's `id` from GET /2/sources. A stream key is also accepted but deprecated; stream keys stop being accepted when the /2/users/:id/sources and /2/users/:id/broadcasts routes reach end of life on January 1, 2027. |
| `telecast_id` | `string` | No | Deprecated: telecast associations are being retired and this field will be ignored. |
| `thumbnail_media_id` | `string` | No | Pre-live slate media id (numeric string). |
| `title` | `string` | No | Title / status text. |

### scheduled.list

`broadcasts.scheduled.list`

Returns scheduled broadcasts owned by the authenticated user. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.broadcasts.scheduled.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `oldest_start_time` | `string` | No | — |
| `newest_start_time` | `string` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | — |

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### scheduled.update

`broadcasts.scheduled.update`

Updates a scheduled broadcast. Path `:id` is the broadcast id; the body must include `scheduled_broadcast_id`. Re-send every field that should be kept. Passing a stream key as `source_id` is deprecated and stops working when the /2/users/:id/sources and /2/users/:id/broadcasts routes reach end of life on January 1, 2027; pass the source's `id` from GET /2/sources instead. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read, broadcast.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.broadcasts.scheduled.update({
	id: '1460323737035677698',
	scheduled_broadcast_id: '1460323737035677698',
	scheduled_start_ms: '1460323737035677698',
	scheduled_end_ms: '1460323737035677698',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `available_for_replay` | `boolean` | No | Enable replay. |
| `chat_option` | `string` | No | Who can chat (numeric string): `0` default, `1` chat off, `2` everyone, `3` verified accounts, `4` accounts the host follows, `5` the host's subscribers, `6` accounts followed by an account the host follows. |
| `description` | `string` | No | Description. |
| `is_locked` | `boolean` | No | Lock the broadcast. |
| `locale` | `string` | No | Locale. |
| `manual_publish` | `boolean` | No | If true, do not auto-publish at start; call POST .../live when ready. |
| `roll_forward` | `boolean` | No | Deprecated: recurring schedules are being retired and `true` will be rejected. |
| `scheduled_broadcast_id` | `string` | Yes | Numeric scheduler id from create/list/get. |
| `scheduled_end_ms` | `string` | Yes | End time, ms since Unix epoch (decimal string). |
| `scheduled_start_ms` | `string` | Yes | Start time, ms since Unix epoch (decimal string). |
| `source_id` | `string` | No | Source to bind: a source's `id` from GET /2/sources. A stream key is also accepted but deprecated; stream keys stop being accepted when the /2/users/:id/sources and /2/users/:id/broadcasts routes reach end of life on January 1, 2027. |
| `thumbnail_media_id` | `string` | No | Pre-live slate media id (numeric string). |
| `title` | `string` | No | Title / status text. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### update

`broadcasts.update`

Changes the title, chat option or live category of one of the authenticated user's broadcasts and returns the broadcast. Send at least one of `title`, `chat_option` and `live_category_id`; fields left out keep their values. A broadcast can be updated before it starts, while it is live and after it has ended. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read, broadcast.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.broadcasts.update({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `chat_option` | `number` | No | Who can chat: 0 default, 1 chat off, 2 everyone, 3 verified accounts, 4 accounts the host follows, 5 the host's subscribers, 6 accounts followed by an account the host follows. |
| `live_category_id` | `string` | No | New live category, e.g. `gaming`. Ids come from GET /2/broadcasts/categories; an unknown id is a 400. An empty string removes the broadcast's category. |
| `title` | `string` | No | New broadcast title. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

## Calls

### create

`calls.create`

Starts an X call hosted by the authenticated user (typically a bot). Pass an XChat conversation_id to start the call in that conversation, or omit it for a standalone call anyone can join with the returned join_url (subject to join_policy). The call starts empty: put an agent in it with POST /2/calls/:id/join. When the host joins a conversation call, the other members are rung. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope calls.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.calls.create({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `audio_only` | `boolean` | No | Start the call without video. |
| `conversation_id` | `string` | No | XChat conversation to start the call in. |
| `join_policy` | `open \| closed \| trusted` | No | open (default): anyone with the link joins; closed: the host admits each person; trusted: members of the host's Verified Organization join, others ask. |
| `title` | `string` | No | Title shown to participants. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### get

`calls.get`

Returns a call's title, join policy, host and participant count, and whether the authenticated user may join it without asking the host. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope calls.read (pass scopes to the plugin).

---

### join

`calls.join`

Starts a media session that takes part in the call as the authenticated user. The response carries a media_url and a short-lived media_token: open a WebSocket to media_url with the token as a Bearer credential to exchange PCM16 audio and events with the call; the user enters the call when the WebSocket connects. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope calls.join (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.calls.join({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `media` | `object` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="media full type">

```ts

  audio?: {
    encoding?: pcm16,
    sample_rate?: number
  },
  type?: websocket
}
```

### leave

`calls.leave`

Ends the authenticated user's media session in the call (its WebSocket receives session.ended with reason left) and removes the user from the call. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope calls.join (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.calls.leave({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### scheduled.cancel

`calls.scheduled.cancel`

Cancels a scheduled call the authenticated user organizes, and takes it off invitees' calendars. For a recurring call, scope and occurrence_start_time pick the occurrences: all of them (the default), one, or one and every one after it. Cancelling what is already cancelled succeeds. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope calls.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.calls.scheduled.cancel({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `scope` | `all \| this \| this_and_following` | No | Which occurrences: all (the default without occurrence_start_time), this (the default with it), or this_and_following. |
| `occurrence_start_time` | `string` | No | Start of the occurrence that scope this or this_and_following refers to (RFC 3339). |
| `notify_invitees` | `boolean` | No | Whether invitees get an email about it. Defaults to true. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>

```ts
  cancelled?: boolean | null
} | null
```

### scheduled.create

`calls.scheduled.create`

Puts an X call on the authenticated user's X Calls calendar, with them as its organizer, and invites people to it. The call exists right away: share its join_url, or put an agent in it at start time with POST /2/calls/:id/join. A recurrence (an RFC 5545 RRULE) repeats it. Invitees get an email unless notify_invitees is false. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope calls.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.calls.scheduled.create({ start_time: '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `description` | `string` | No | What the call is about. |
| `duration_minutes` | `number` | No | How long the call lasts, in minutes. Defaults to 30; at most 31 days. |
| `invitee_ids` | `string[]` | No | X user ids of the people to invite. |
| `notify_invitees` | `boolean` | No | Whether invitees get an email about the call. Defaults to true. |
| `recurrence` | `string` | No | RFC 5545 RRULE to repeat the call by, such as FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO; the RRULE: prefix is optional. |
| `start_time` | `string` | Yes | When the call starts (RFC 3339); not in the past. |
| `time_zone` | `string` | No | IANA time zone the recurrence follows, such as America/Los_Angeles. |
| `title` | `string` | No | Title invitees see. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### scheduled.get

`calls.scheduled.get`

Returns a scheduled call the authenticated user organizes or is invited to, at its occurrence running now or its next one within a year: its time, call, recurrence and who is invited and how they answered. Changes can take a few seconds to show here. Use scheduled_call.fields to select which fields are returned. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope calls.read (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.calls.scheduled.get({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `scheduled_call.fields` | `(calendar \| call_id \| description \| end_time \| id \| join_url \| occurrence_start_time \| recurrence \| start_time \| status \| time_zone \| title)[]` | No | A comma separated list of ScheduledCall fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(call_id \| invitees \| organizer_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `call.fields` | `(conversation_id \| created_at \| id \| join_policy \| join_url \| participant_count \| title \| viewer_may_join)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Call fields to display. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### scheduled.list

`calls.scheduled.list`

Returns the X calls on the authenticated user's calendar, earliest first: events on their X Calls calendar, and events on the Microsoft Outlook calendars they linked to X whose conference is an X call. Calls still running at start_time are included. The window defaults to the next 24 hours and may span at most 7 days. Use scheduled_call.fields to select which fields are returned. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope calls.read (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.calls.scheduled.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `start_time` | `string` | No | Calls still running at this time or starting after it (RFC 3339). Defaults to now. |
| `end_time` | `string` | No | Calls starting before this time (RFC 3339). Defaults to 24 hours after start_time. |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | The most calls to return. Defaults to 20. |
| `scheduled_call.fields` | `(calendar \| call_id \| description \| end_time \| id \| join_url \| occurrence_start_time \| recurrence \| start_time \| status \| time_zone \| title)[]` | No | A comma separated list of ScheduledCall fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(call_id \| invitees \| organizer_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `call.fields` | `(conversation_id \| created_at \| id \| join_policy \| join_url \| participant_count \| title \| viewer_may_join)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Call fields to display. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### scheduled.respond

`calls.scheduled.respond`

Accepts, declines or tentatively accepts an invitation to a scheduled call for the authenticated user. For a recurring call, scope and occurrence_start_time pick the occurrences the answer is for: all of them (the default), one, or one and every one after it. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope calls.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.calls.scheduled.respond({ id: '1460323737035677698', response: 'accepted' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `occurrence_start_time` | `string` | No | Start of the occurrence that scope this or this_and_following refers to (RFC 3339). |
| `response` | `accepted \| declined \| tentative` | Yes | The answer to the invitation. |
| `scope` | `all \| this \| this_and_following` | No | Which occurrences of a recurring call: all (the default without occurrence_start_time), this (the default with it), or this_and_following. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### scheduled.update

`calls.scheduled.update`

Moves, renames or re-invites a scheduled call the authenticated user organizes. Only the fields sent change. For a recurring call, scope and occurrence_start_time pick the occurrences: all of them (the default), one, or one and every one after it. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope calls.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.calls.scheduled.update({ id: '1460323737035677698', start_time: '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `description` | `string` | No | What the call is about. |
| `duration_minutes` | `number` | No | How long the call lasts, in minutes. |
| `invitee_ids` | `string[]` | No | Everyone to invite: replaces the invite list. At most 25 of them may be people not invited yet. |
| `notify_invitees` | `boolean` | No | Whether invitees get an email about the change. Defaults to true. |
| `occurrence_start_time` | `string` | No | Start of the occurrence that scope this or this_and_following refers to (RFC 3339). |
| `recurrence` | `string` | No | RFC 5545 RRULE to repeat the call by, such as FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO. |
| `scope` | `all \| this \| this_and_following` | No | Which occurrences of a recurring call: all (the default without occurrence_start_time), this (the default with it), or this_and_following. |
| `start_time` | `string` | No | When the call (or the chosen occurrence) starts now (RFC 3339). |
| `time_zone` | `string` | No | IANA time zone the recurrence follows. |
| `title` | `string` | No | Title invitees see. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

## Chat

### conversations.addKeys

`chat.conversations.addKeys`

Adds (initializes or rotates) the encryption keys for a Chat conversation. Call this before sending messages in a new 1:1 conversation, and again with a newer key version to rotate the conversation key. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID as the conversation id; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.conversations.addKeys({
	id: '1460323737035677698',
	conversation_key_version: '1460323737035677698',
	conversation_participant_keys: [{ user_id: '2244994945', encrypted_conversation_key: '1460323737035677698', public_key_version: '1460323737035677698' }],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `action_signatures` | `object[]` | No | Signatures for this action, forwarded in the order they are sent. |
| `base64_encoded_key_rotation` | `string` | No | Base64-encoded key rotation payload for ratchet tree key management. |
| `conversation_key_version` | `string` | Yes | Version of the conversation encryption key (typically a timestamp in milliseconds). |
| `conversation_participant_keys` | `object[]` | Yes | Encrypted conversation keys for each participant. |

<AccordionGroup>

```ts
  encoded_message_event_detail: string,

      signing_public_key?: string

    signing_public_key?: string
  },

  signature_payload?: string
}[]
```

### conversations.archive

`chat.conversations.archive`

Archives a Chat conversation for the authenticated user only. Archiving an archived conversation changes nothing. Works for group and 1:1 conversations. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.conversations.archive({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the conversation: a group ID starting with `g`, the other user's ID for a 1:1 conversation, or both user IDs of a 1:1 conversation joined by a hyphen. |
| `action_signatures` | `object[]` | No | Signatures for this action, forwarded in the order they are sent. |

### conversations.delete

`chat.conversations.delete`

Deletes a Chat conversation for the authenticated user only; other participants keep it. Works for group and 1:1 conversations. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. Deleting a pending message request's conversation deletes the request, like Delete in the X app. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.conversations.delete({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the conversation: a group ID starting with `g`, the other user's ID for a 1:1 conversation, or both user IDs of a 1:1 conversation joined by a hyphen. |
| `action_signatures` | `object[]` | No | Signatures for this action, forwarded in the order they are sent. |

### conversations.disableMessageTtl

Stops new messages in a 1:1 or group Chat conversation from disappearing, for every participant. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

### conversations.enableMessageTtl

`chat.conversations.enableMessageTtl`

Sets how long new messages in a 1:1 or group Chat conversation last before they disappear, for every participant. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

---

### conversations.get

`chat.conversations.get`

Returns metadata for a Chat conversation including type, muted status, group details, and your unread state. For the unread state, request chat_conversation.fields=unread,last_read_event_id,newest_event_id: those fields give your read state, computed from your latest read receipt and the conversation's latest notifying message. Use chat_conversation.fields to select which fields are returned. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.conversations.get({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `chat_conversation.fields` | `(admin_settings \| created_at \| group_avatar_url \| group_description \| group_description_key_version \| group_name \| id \| invite \| is_archived \| is_muted \| last_read_event_id \| message_ttl_ms \| newest_event_id \| pending_member_ids \| screen_capture_blocking_enabled \| screen_capture_detection_enabled \| type \| unread \| updated_at)[]` | No | A comma separated list of ChatConversation fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(admin_ids \| member_ids \| participant_ids)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |

---

### conversations.list

`chat.conversations.list`

Retrieves a list of Chat conversations for the authenticated user's inbox, newest first: the most recently active conversation comes first. To find the chat with a particular person, start with participant_query set to their @username or name; with expansions=participant_ids, user.fields=receives_your_chat says how you can message each match. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.conversations.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `max_results` | `number` | No | Conversations covered per page (1-1000, default 200). Filtered pages can return fewer. |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | meta.next_token from the previous page. Send the same filters with it, or the request fails. |
| `unread_only` | `boolean` | No | Return only unread conversations. A page can be short; keep paging while has_more. |
| `type` | `direct \| group` | No | Only direct (1:1) or only group conversations. Omit for both. |
| `is_archived` | `boolean` | No | true: only archived; false: only not archived. Omit for both. |
| `is_muted` | `boolean` | No | true: only muted; false: only not muted. Omit for both. |
| `participant_ids` | `string[]` | No | Comma-separated numeric user IDs (1-10), all in the chat. Names or @handles: use participant_query. |
| `participant_query` | `string` | No | Start here to find someone's chat: their @username or a word of their name (1-50 chars). |
| `start_time` | `string` | No | ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-16T00:00:00Z. Chats whose latest message is at or after this time. |
| `end_time` | `string` | No | ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-17T00:00:00Z. Chats whose latest message is before this time. |
| `chat_conversation.fields` | `(admin_settings \| created_at \| group_avatar_url \| group_description \| group_description_key_version \| group_name \| id \| invite \| is_archived \| is_muted \| last_read_event_id \| message_ttl_ms \| newest_event_id \| pending_member_ids \| screen_capture_blocking_enabled \| screen_capture_detection_enabled \| type \| unread \| updated_at)[]` | No | A comma separated list of ChatConversation fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(admin_ids \| member_ids \| participant_ids)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### conversations.listEvents

`chat.conversations.listEvents`

Retrieves the events of a specific Chat conversation, newest first, with pagination support: messages, key changes, group changes, and read receipts. Events with an id above the conversation's last_read_event_id are unread: they come after the point you read up to. To collect them, page until an event's id is at or below it. Only `id` and `encoded_event` are always present. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.conversations.listEvents({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | The maximum number of events to return. |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | The next_token from a previous response, to fetch the next page. |
| `chat_message_event.fields` | `(conversation_id \| conversation_key_version \| conversation_token \| created_at \| encoded_event \| id \| is_trusted \| message_event_signature \| previous_id \| sender_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of ChatMessageEvent fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### conversations.listPinnedMessages

`chat.conversations.listPinnedMessages`

Retrieves the pinned message events of a Chat conversation with pagination support. Each event is a Base64-encoded Thrift pin event whose contents are end-to-end encrypted; decode and decrypt it client-side. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.conversations.listPinnedMessages({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the conversation: a group ID starting with `g`, the other user's ID for a 1:1 conversation, or both user IDs of a 1:1 conversation joined by a hyphen. |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | The next_token from a previous response, to fetch the next page. |
| `chat_pinned_message.fields` | `encoded_event[]` | No | A comma separated list of ChatPinnedMessage fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### conversations.markRead

`chat.conversations.markRead`

Marks a specific Chat conversation as read on behalf of the authenticated user. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. Without action_signatures the conversation is marked read up to its newest event and the read receipt is unsigned. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.conversations.markRead({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `action_signatures` | `object[]` | No | Signature over the read receipt (a MarkConversationReadEvent). Omit to send it unsigned. |

### conversations.mute

`chat.conversations.mute`

Mutes notifications for a Chat conversation for the authenticated user only. Works for group and 1:1 conversations. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.conversations.mute({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the conversation: a group ID starting with `g`, the other user's ID for a 1:1 conversation, or both user IDs of a 1:1 conversation joined by a hyphen. |
| `action_signatures` | `object[]` | No | Signatures for this action, forwarded in the order they are sent. |

### conversations.sendTyping

`chat.conversations.sendTyping`

Sends a typing indicator to a specific Chat conversation on behalf of the authenticated user. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.conversations.sendTyping({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### conversations.unarchive

`chat.conversations.unarchive`

Unarchives a Chat conversation for the authenticated user only. Unarchiving a conversation that is not archived changes nothing. Works for group and 1:1 conversations. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.conversations.unarchive({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the conversation: a group ID starting with `g`, the other user's ID for a 1:1 conversation, or both user IDs of a 1:1 conversation joined by a hyphen. |
| `action_signatures` | `object[]` | No | Signatures for this action, forwarded in the order they are sent. |

```ts
    }[],
    public_key_version: string,
    signature: string,

  },
```

### conversations.unmute

`chat.conversations.unmute`

Unmutes notifications for a Chat conversation for the authenticated user only. Works for group and 1:1 conversations. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.conversations.unmute({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

### conversations.updateScreenCapture

`chat.conversations.updateScreenCapture`

Turns screenshot blocking or screenshot detection on or off in a Chat conversation, for every participant. In a group conversation, only admins can change these settings. Each request changes one setting: send either blocking or detection. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.conversations.updateScreenCapture({ id: '1460323737035677698', blocking: true });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the conversation: a group ID starting with `g`, the other user's ID for a 1:1 conversation, or both user IDs of a 1:1 conversation joined by a hyphen. |
| `blocking` | `boolean` | No | Whether participants are prevented from taking screenshots. |
| `blocking_action_signatures` | `object[]` | No | Signatures for the screenshot blocking change, forwarded in the order they are sent. |
| `detection` | `boolean` | No | Whether participants are notified when someone takes a screenshot. |
| `detection_action_signatures` | `object[]` | No | Signatures for the screenshot detection change, forwarded in the order they are sent. |

### groups.adminRequests.create

`chat.groups.adminRequests.create`

Asks the admins of an encrypted Chat group conversation to make the authenticated user an admin. An admin approves or rejects the request. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.groups.adminRequests.create({ id: 'g1460323737035677698' });
```

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the group conversation, starting with `g`. |
| `action_signatures` | `object[]` | No | Signatures for this action, forwarded in the order they are sent. |

### groups.adminRequests.list

`chat.groups.adminRequests.list`

Returns the users who have asked to become admins of an encrypted Chat group conversation. Only a group admin can list admin requests. Use user.fields to select which profile fields are returned. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.groups.adminRequests.list({ id: 'g1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the group conversation, starting with `g`. |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | The next_token from a previous response, to fetch the next page. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(affiliation \| most_recent_post_id \| pinned_post_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

---

### groups.adminRequests.reject

`chat.groups.adminRequests.reject`

Declines a user's pending request for admin permissions in an encrypted Chat group conversation. Only a group admin can reject. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.groups.adminRequests.reject({ id: 'g1460323737035677698', user_id: '2244994945' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the group conversation, starting with `g`. |
| `user_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the user who requested admin permissions. |
| `action_signatures` | `object[]` | No | Signatures for this action, forwarded in the order they are sent. |

### groups.admins.remove

Revokes admin rights from one or more admins of an existing encrypted Chat group conversation. They stay members of the group. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.groups.admins.remove({
	id: 'g1460323737035677698',
```

### groups.create

`chat.groups.create`

Creates a new encrypted Chat group conversation on behalf of the authenticated user. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.groups.create({
	conversation_id: '1460323737035677698',
	conversation_key_version: '1460323737035677698',
	conversation_participant_keys: [{ user_id: '2244994945', encrypted_conversation_key: '1460323737035677698', public_key_version: '1460323737035677698' }],
	group_members: ['1460323737035677698'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `action_signatures` | `object[]` | No | Signatures for this action, forwarded in the order they are sent. |
| `base64_encoded_key_rotation` | `string` | No | Base64-encoded key rotation payload. |
| `conversation_id` | `string` | Yes | Client-generated conversation ID. |
| `conversation_key_version` | `string` | Yes | Version of the conversation encryption key. |
| `conversation_participant_keys` | `object[]` | Yes | Encrypted conversation keys for each participant. |
| `group_admins` | `string[]` | No | User IDs of group admins. Defaults to the creator if omitted. |

### groups.initialize

`chat.groups.initialize`

Initializes a new Chat group conversation and returns a unique conversation ID. Use the returned conversation_id in a subsequent POST /chat/conversations/group call to fully create and configure the group. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.groups.initialize({});
```

### groups.inviteLink.disable

`chat.groups.inviteLink.disable`

Turns off the invite link for an encrypted Chat group conversation. The existing link stops working. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.groups.inviteLink.disable({ id: 'g1460323737035677698' });
```

| `id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the group conversation, starting with `g`. |
| `action_signatures` | `object[]` | No | Signatures for this action, forwarded in the order they are sent. |

### groups.inviteLink.enable

`chat.groups.inviteLink.enable`

Turns on the invite link for an encrypted Chat group conversation and returns the link details. The client builds the link and sends it as invite_url, in the form https://x.com/i/chat/group_join/&lt;conversation_id&gt;/&lt;token&gt;, where the token is exactly 10 letters, digits, '-' or '_'. invite_url is required when action_signatures is sent. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.groups.inviteLink.enable({ id: 'g1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the group conversation, starting with `g`. |
| `action_signatures` | `object[]` | No | Signatures for this action, forwarded in the order they are sent. |
| `affiliate_user_id` | `string` | No | ID of the affiliate account to associate with the link. |
| `decrypted_avatar_url` | `string` | No | Group avatar URL (https) to show on the invite preview. |
| `decrypted_title` | `string` | No | Group name to show on the invite preview. |
| `invite_url` | `string` | No | Invite link built by the client, in the form https://x.com/i/chat/group_join/&lt;conversation_id&gt;/&lt;token&gt;, where the token is exactly 10 letters, digits, '-' or '_'. The conversation segment must match the path ID. It is part of the signed payload, so it is required when action_signatures is sent. |
| `validity_duration_msec` | `string` | No | How long the link stays valid, in milliseconds, from the time of the request. With action_signatures, send validity_expiry_timestamp_msec instead. |
| `validity_expiry_timestamp_msec` | `string` | No | When the link expires, in epoch milliseconds. Must be in the future. If validity_duration_msec is also sent, the two must agree within a minute. |
| `welcome_message` | `string` | No | Message shown to people who open the link. |

```ts
}[]
```

### groups.inviteLink.get

`chat.groups.inviteLink.get`

Returns the preview of an encrypted Chat group conversation from its invite link: group name, avatar, member count, and the authenticated user's join state. The conversation ID and the token both come from the invite link. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.groups.inviteLink.get({ id: 'g1460323737035677698', token: 'abcdefghij' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the group conversation, starting with `g`. |
| `token` | `string` | Yes | The 10-character invite token from the group's invite link. |
| `chat_group_invite.fields` | `(conversation_id \| expires_at \| group_avatar_url \| group_name \| invite_url \| join_state \| member_count \| token \| welcome_message)[]` | No | A comma separated list of ChatGroupInvite fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### groups.joinRequests.create

`chat.groups.joinRequests.create`

Asks to join an encrypted Chat group conversation through its invite link. The request stays pending until a group admin adds the user to the group. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.groups.joinRequests.create({ id: 'g1460323737035677698', token: 'abcdefghij' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the group conversation, starting with `g`. |
| `action_signatures` | `object[]` | No | Signatures for this action, forwarded in the order they are sent. |
| `token` | `string` | Yes | The 10-character invite token from the group's invite link. |

### groups.joinRequests.reject

`chat.groups.joinRequests.reject`

Rejects pending requests to join an encrypted Chat group conversation. Only group admins can reject requests. To approve a request instead, add the requesting users with addChatGroupMembers; adding a user clears their pending request. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.groups.joinRequests.reject({
	id: 'g1460323737035677698',
	user_ids: ['2244994945'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the group conversation, starting with `g`. |
| `action_signatures` | `object[]` | No | Signatures for this action, forwarded in the order they are sent. |
| `user_ids` | `string[]` | Yes | List of user IDs whose join requests to reject. |

### groups.members.add

`chat.groups.members.add`

Adds one or more members to an existing encrypted Chat group conversation, rotating the conversation key. Adding a user who has a pending join request approves that request; approval needs the same key-rotation body as adding any member. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.groups.members.add({
	id: '1460323737035677698',
	user_ids: ['2244994945'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `action_signatures` | `object[]` | No | Signatures for this action, forwarded in the order they are sent. |
| `conversation_key_version` | `string` | No | Version of the new rotated conversation key. |
| `conversation_participant_keys` | `object[]` | No | Encrypted conversation keys for each participant. |
| `encrypted_avatar_url` | `string` | No | Re-encrypted group avatar URL with new conversation key. |
| `encrypted_title` | `string` | No | Re-encrypted group title with new conversation key. |
| `user_ids` | `string[]` | Yes | List of user IDs to add to the group conversation. |
