### groups.members.remove

`chat.groups.members.remove`

Removes one or more members from an existing encrypted Chat group conversation. To leave a group, pass your own user ID. Leaving does not delete the conversation for the caller. When the removal rotates the conversation key, send group_key_rotation_data and the action signatures for the removal and the key change, in that order. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.groups.members.remove({
	id: '1460323737035677698',
	user_ids: ['2244994945'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `action_signatures` | `object[]` | No | Signatures for this action, forwarded in the order they are sent. |
| `group_key_rotation_data` | `object` | No | — |
| `user_ids` | `string[]` | Yes | List of user IDs to remove from the group conversation. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="action_signatures full type">

```ts
{
  encoded_message_event_detail: string,
  message_event_signature: {
    message_signing_key_info_list?: {
      member_id?: string,
      public_key_version?: string,
      signing_public_key?: string
    }[],
    public_key_version: string,
    signature: string,
    signature_version: string,
    signing_public_key?: string
  },
  message_id: string,
  signature_payload?: string
}[]
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="group_key_rotation_data full type">

```ts
{
  base64_encoded_key_rotation?: string,
  conversation_key_version?: string,
  conversation_participant_keys?: {
    encrypted_conversation_key: string,
    public_key_version: string,
    user_id: string
  }[],
  encrypted_avatar?: string,
  encrypted_description?: string,
  encrypted_title?: string,
  rotated_pmk_bundle?: {
    base64_encoded_encrypted_pmk: string,
    message_sequence_id: string,
    pme_sequence_id?: string
  }[]
}
```

### groups.update

`chat.groups.update`

Renames an encrypted Chat group conversation, changes its avatar, or sets its description. The client encrypts each value with the conversation key and lists the values it changed in modified_fields. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.groups.update({
	id: 'g1460323737035677698',
	modified_fields: ['group_name'],
	conversation_key_version: '1460323737035677698',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

### groups.updateAdminSettings

`chat.groups.updateAdminSettings`

Sets which actions only admins can perform in an existing encrypted Chat group conversation. A setting set to true restricts that action to admins, and false opens it to all members. Setting `send_message` to true makes the group announcement-only. Omitted settings keep their stored value. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.groups.updateAdminSettings({ id: 'g1460323737035677698', add_member: true });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the group conversation, starting with `g`. |
| `action_signatures` | `object[]` | No | Signatures for this action, forwarded in the order they are sent. |
| `add_member` | `boolean` | No | When true, only admins can add members. |
| `block_screen_capture` | `boolean` | No | When true, only admins can change screen capture blocking. Through the API, only admins can change screen capture in a group, whatever this setting says. |
| `edit_group_info` | `boolean` | No | When true, only admins can edit the group name, avatar, and description. |
| `edit_message_ttl` | `boolean` | No | When true, only admins can change the disappearing-message timer. |
| `send_message` | `boolean` | No | When true, only admins can send messages. |
| `start_call` | `boolean` | No | When true, only admins can start calls. |

### media.appendUpload

`chat.media.appendUpload`

Appends media data to an XChat upload session. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.media.appendUpload({
	id: '1460323737035677698',
	media: { base64: 'iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==', filename: 'pixel.png', contentType: 'image/png' },
	segment_index: 1,
	conversation_id: '1460323737035677698',
	media_hash_key: '1460323737035677698',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `conversation_id` | `string` | Yes | The XChat conversation the upload belongs to. |
| `media` | `string \| object \| custom` | Yes | The media segment bytes: base64-encoded in JSON bodies, raw bytes in multipart bodies. |
| `media_hash_key` | `string` | Yes | The media hash key returned by the initialize step. |
| `segment_index` | `number` | Yes | The index of this segment in the upload sequence. |

### media.download

`chat.media.download`

Downloads encrypted media bytes from an XChat conversation. The response body contains raw binary bytes. A media item too large to return in one response fails with a 413 problem of type `https://api.x.com/2/problems/response-too-large`, and a retry fails the same way. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.media.download({ id: '1460323737035677698', media_hash_key: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `media_hash_key` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contentBase64` | `string` | No | The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set. |
| `text` | `string` | No | The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8. |
| `contentType` | `string` | Yes | Media type of the file, for example application/pdf. |
| `byteLength` | `number` | Yes | Size of the file in bytes. |
| `filename` | `string` | No | The file name, when known. |
| `contentOmitted` | `not_requested \| over_limit` | No | Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit. |
| `fileId` | `string` | No | Where the host saved the file. Over the limit it comes in place of the content; a host that keeps every file sets it beside the content too. On Corsair it is a Files id (fil_…): pass it to another app wherever that app takes a file URL, or read a text file or PDF with files.read_text. |

### media.finalizeUpload

`chat.media.finalizeUpload`

Finalizes an XChat media upload session. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.media.finalizeUpload({
	id: '1460323737035677698',
	conversation_id: '1460323737035677698',
	media_hash_key: '1460323737035677698',
	num_parts: '1460323737035677698',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `conversation_id` | `string` | Yes | The XChat conversation the upload belongs to. |
| `media_hash_key` | `string` | Yes | The media hash key returned by the initialize step. |
| `message_id` | `string` | No | Optional message identifier associated with the upload. |
| `num_parts` | `string` | Yes | Total number of uploaded parts, as a numeric string. |
| `ttl_msec` | `string` | No | Optional TTL for the media in milliseconds, as a numeric string. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### messageRequests.accept

`chat.messageRequests.accept`

Accepts the other user's pending message request in a 1:1 Chat conversation, which moves to the authenticated user's inbox. Without a pending request, including after a successful accept, the response is 404. Replying to a request does not accept it. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.messageRequests.accept({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The other user's ID, or both user IDs joined by a hyphen. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### messageRequests.get

`chat.messageRequests.get`

Retrieves the message request state of a 1:1 Chat conversation and its newest message events. Like opening the request in an X app, reading it marks the returned messages as delivered and updates the unread badge. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.messageRequests.get({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The other user's ID, or both user IDs joined by a hyphen. |
| `chat_message_request_detail.fields` | `(conversation_id \| conversation_key_events \| has_more_events \| message_events \| message_request_state \| participant_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of ChatMessageRequestDetail fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### messageRequests.list

`chat.messageRequests.list`

Retrieves the authenticated user's pending Chat message requests from one inbox. Message contents are end-to-end encrypted unless the conversation is unencrypted. Accepting or deleting requests between pages can skip or repeat requests, and a page can be empty while `next_token` is set. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.messageRequests.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `inbox_type` | `you_may_know \| low_quality` | No | Which message request inbox to list: `you_may_know` (the apps' Priority tab) or `low_quality` (the apps' Hidden tab). |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | The maximum number of message requests to return. |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | The next_token from a previous response, to fetch the next page. |
| `chat_message_request.fields` | `(conversation_id \| conversation_key_events \| encoded_message_create_event \| has_more_events \| message_events \| sender_id \| sender_recently_modified_profile \| social_proof_user_ids)[]` | No | A comma separated list of ChatMessageRequest fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">


### messages.delete

`chat.messages.delete`

Deletes one or more messages from a Chat conversation. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. Delete for all removes a message you sent (or, in groups you administer, any message) for every participant; delete for self removes any message only from your own view. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.messages.delete({
	id: '1460323737035677698',
	sequence_ids: ['1460323737035677698'],
	delete_message_action: 'delete_for_all',
	action_signatures: [{
		message_id: '1460323737035677698',
		encoded_message_event_detail: '1460323737035677698',
		message_event_signature: { signature: '1460323737035677698', public_key_version: '1460323737035677698', signature_version: '1460323737035677698' },
	}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `action_signatures` | `object[]` | Yes | Signatures for this action, forwarded in the order they are sent. |
| `delete_message_action` | `delete_for_all \| delete_for_self` | Yes | delete_for_all removes the messages for every participant; delete_for_self removes them only from the authenticated user's view. |
| `media_hash_keys` | `string[]` | No | Hash keys of encrypted media blobs to delete alongside the messages (delete_for_all only). |
| `sequence_ids` | `string[]` | Yes | Sequence IDs of the messages to delete. |

### messages.send

`chat.messages.send`

Sends a message or reaction to a Chat conversation, which you can find with `participant_query` on Get Chat Conversations. Send it end-to-end encrypted by default: `encoded_message_create_event`, built with the Chat XDK. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.messages.send({ id: '1460323737035677698', message_id: '1460323737035677698', encoded_message_create_event: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | A conversation's id from Get Chat Conversations, or the recipient's user ID for a 1:1 chat. |
| `content` | `object` | No | — |
| `conversation_token` | `string` | No | Optional conversation token. |
| `encoded_message_create_event` | `string` | No | Default. The end-to-end encrypted message: a base64 Thrift MessageCreateEvent from the Chat XDK. |
| `encoded_message_event_signature` | `string` | No | Base64-encoded Thrift MessageEventSignature for message verification. |
| `message_id` | `string` | Yes | Unique identifier for this message. |
| `xdk_version` | `string` | No | Version of the Chat XDK that produced the payload. |

```ts
}
```

### settings.get

`chat.settings.get`

Returns the authenticated user's Chat privacy settings: who can message them, read receipts, the message quality filter, and audio/video call permissions. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.settings.get({});
```

### settings.update

`chat.settings.update`

Updates the authenticated user's Chat privacy settings: who can message them, read receipts, the message quality filter, and audio/video call permissions. allow_dms_from, dm_receipt_settings, and dm_quality_filter accept only their listed values, matched exactly and case-sensitively; anything else is a 400. av_settings must set at least one of its settings. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.chat.settings.update({ allow_dms_from: 'all' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `allow_dms_from` | `all \| verified \| following` | No | Who can send the user messages: `all` (anyone), `verified` (verified accounts only), or `following` (accounts the user follows). A bot may get a 400 for choosing `following` when it doesn't already have it, and an org-only bot for choosing `verified`. |
| `always_allow_dms_from_subscribers` | `boolean` | No | Whether the user's subscribers can always message them regardless of allow_dms_from. |
| `av_settings` | `object` | No | — |
| `dm_quality_filter` | `enabled \| disabled` | No | Low-quality message request filter: `enabled` (low-quality requests go to a separate folder) or `disabled` (all requests stay in the main inbox). |
| `dm_receipt_settings` | `all_enabled \| all_disabled` | No | Read receipts: `all_enabled` (send and receive read receipts) or `all_disabled` (neither). |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="av_settings full type">

```ts
{
  av_call_permissions?: {
    accept_calls_from_addressbook?: boolean,
    accept_calls_from_everyone?: boolean,
    accept_calls_from_following?: boolean,
    accept_calls_from_verified?: boolean
  },
  has_av_calls_enabled?: boolean,
  has_enhanced_call_privacy_enabled?: boolean
}
```
</Accordion>

### search

`communities.search`

Retrieves a list of Communities matching the specified search query. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.communities.search({ query: 'from:XDevelopers -is:retweet' });
```

| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | — |
| `community.fields` | `(access \| created_at \| description \| id \| join_policy \| member_count \| name)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Community fields to display. |

## Community Notes

### create

`communityNotes.create`

Creates a Community Note on a Post. With test_mode set to true, the note is only for testing and is not publicly visible. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.communityNotes.create({
	test_mode: true,
	post_id: '1460323737035677698',
	info: {
		text: 'The photo is from 2019, not this week: https://example.com/source',
		classification: 'misinformed_or_potentially_misleading',
		misleading_tags: ['disputed_claim_as_fact'],
		trustworthy_sources: true,
	},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `info` | `object` | Yes | — |
| `post_id` | `string` | Yes | ID of the Post the note is about. |
| `test_mode` | `boolean` | Yes | If true, the note is only for testing and is not publicly visible. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="info full type">

```ts
{
  classification: misinformed_or_potentially_misleading | not_misleading,
  is_media_note?: boolean,
  misleading_tags: (disputed_claim_as_fact | factual_error | manipulated_media | misinterpreted_satire | missing_important_context | other | outdated_information)[],
  text: string,
  trustworthy_sources: boolean
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### evaluate

`communityNotes.evaluate`

Evaluates the text of a proposed Community Note on a Post and returns its claim-opinion score. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.communityNotes.evaluate({ post_id: '1460323737035677698', note_text: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `note_text` | `string` | Yes | Text of the community note to evaluate. |
| `post_id` | `string` | Yes | ID of the Post the note evaluates. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### searchEligiblePosts

`communityNotes.searchEligiblePosts`

Retrieves Posts that are eligible for Community Notes. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.communityNotes.searchEligiblePosts({ test_mode: true });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `test_mode` | `boolean` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | — |
| `post_selection` | `string` | No | — |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(article.cover_media \| article.media_entities \| attachments.media_keys \| attachments.media_source_tweet \| attachments.poll_ids \| author_id \| edit_history_post_ids \| entities.mentions.username \| geo.place_id \| in_reply_to_user_id \| referenced_posts \| username)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `media.fields` | `(alt_text \| duration_ms \| height \| media_key \| non_public_metrics \| organic_metrics \| preview_image_url \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| revenue \| type \| url \| variants \| width)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Media fields to display. |
| `poll.fields` | `(duration_minutes \| end_datetime \| id \| options \| voting_status)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Poll fields to display. |
| `place.fields` | `(contained_within \| country \| country_code \| full_name \| geo \| id \| name \| place_type)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Place fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### searchWritten

`communityNotes.searchWritten`

Retrieves the Community Notes written by the authenticated user. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

## Compliance

### jobs.cancel

`compliance.jobs.cancel`

Cancels a Compliance Job that has not finished processing; its status becomes failed and a new job of the same type can be created. Needs app-only auth: X accepts only the app's Bearer token here (connect with authType 'api_key').

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.compliance.jobs.cancel({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `compliance_job.fields` | `(created_at \| download_expires_at \| download_url \| id \| name \| resumable \| status \| type \| upload_expires_at \| upload_url)[]` | No | A comma separated list of ComplianceJob fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### jobs.downloadResults

`compliance.jobs.downloadResults`

Downloads the results file of a completed Compliance Job using the signed URL returned at job creation. Needs app-only auth: X accepts only the app's Bearer token here (connect with authType 'api_key').

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.compliance.jobs.downloadResults({ id: '1460323737035677698', token: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `token` | `string` | Yes | Signed download token from the job's download_url. |
| `compliance_job.fields` | `(created_at \| download_expires_at \| download_url \| id \| name \| resumable \| status \| type \| upload_expires_at \| upload_url)[]` | No | A comma separated list of ComplianceJob fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contentBase64` | `string` | No | The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set. |
| `text` | `string` | No | The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8. |
| `contentType` | `string` | Yes | Media type of the file, for example application/pdf. |
| `byteLength` | `number` | Yes | Size of the file in bytes. |
| `filename` | `string` | No | The file name, when known. |
| `contentOmitted` | `not_requested \| over_limit` | No | Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit. |
| `fileId` | `string` | No | Where the host saved the file. Over the limit it comes in place of the content; a host that keeps every file sets it beside the content too. On Corsair it is a Files id (fil_…): pass it to another app wherever that app takes a file URL, or read a text file or PDF with files.read_text. |

### jobs.upload

`compliance.jobs.upload`

Uploads the newline-delimited ID file for a Compliance Job using the signed URL returned at job creation. Needs app-only auth: X accepts only the app's Bearer token here (connect with authType 'api_key').

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.compliance.jobs.upload({
	id: '1460323737035677698',
	token: '1460323737035677698',
	file: { base64: 'iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==', filename: 'pixel.png', contentType: 'image/png' },
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `token` | `string` | Yes | Signed upload token from the job's upload_url. |
| `compliance_job.fields` | `(created_at \| download_expires_at \| download_url \| id \| name \| resumable \| status \| type \| upload_expires_at \| upload_url)[]` | No | A comma separated list of ComplianceJob fields to display. |
| `file` | `string \| object \| custom` | Yes | The file to upload: a public URL, &#123; url &#125;, &#123; base64 &#125;, or a Blob. For a compliance job, a text file with one post or user ID per line. |

```ts
string | {

  filename?: string,
  contentType?: string
} | {

} | custom
```

## Connections

### history

`connections.history`

Returns active and historical streaming connections with disconnect reasons for the authenticated application. Needs app-only auth: X accepts only the app's Bearer token here (connect with authType 'api_key').

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.connections.history({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `status` | `active \| inactive \| all` | No | — |
| `endpoints` | `(filtered_stream \| sample_stream \| sample10_stream \| firehose_stream \| tweets_compliance_stream \| users_compliance_stream \| tweet_label_stream \| firehose_stream_lang_en \| firehose_stream_lang_ja \| firehose_stream_lang_ko \| firehose_stream_lang_pt \| likes_firehose_stream \| likes_sample10_stream \| likes_compliance_stream)[]` | No | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | — |
| `connection.fields` | `(client_ip \| connected_at \| disconnect_reason \| disconnected_at \| endpoint_name \| id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Connection fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

## Direct Messages

### conversations.create

`directMessages.conversations.create`

Initiates a new direct message conversation with specified participants. Billed by X: $0.015 per Direct Message. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.directMessages.conversations.create({
	conversation_type: 'Group',
	participant_ids: ['2244994945', '2244994945'],
	message: {},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `conversation_type` | `Group` | Yes | The conversation type to create. Supports `Group` only. |
| `message` | `object` | Yes | — |
| `participant_ids` | `string[]` | Yes | Participants for the conversation. |

---

### events.get

`directMessages.events.get`

Retrieves details of a specific direct message event by its ID. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.directMessages.events.get({ event_id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `event_id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `dm_event.fields` | `(attachments \| created_at \| dm_conversation_id \| entities \| event_type \| id \| text)[]` | No | A comma separated list of DmEvent fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(attachments.media_keys \| participant_ids \| referenced_posts \| sender_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |
| `media.fields` | `(alt_text \| duration_ms \| height \| media_key \| non_public_metrics \| organic_metrics \| preview_image_url \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| revenue \| type \| url \| variants \| width)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Media fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |

---

### events.list

`directMessages.events.list`

Retrieves a list of recent direct message events across all conversations. Billed by X per DM event returned ($0.010 each). Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.directMessages.events.list({
	max_results: 10,
	event_types: ['MessageCreate'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `event_types` | `(MessageCreate \| ParticipantsJoin \| ParticipantsLeave)[]` | No | — |
| `dm_event.fields` | `(attachments \| created_at \| dm_conversation_id \| entities \| event_type \| id \| text)[]` | No | A comma separated list of DmEvent fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(attachments.media_keys \| participant_ids \| referenced_posts \| sender_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |
| `media.fields` | `(alt_text \| duration_ms \| height \| media_key \| non_public_metrics \| organic_metrics \| preview_image_url \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| revenue \| type \| url \| variants \| width)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Media fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### events.listByConversation

**Risk:** `read`

### events.listWithParticipant

`directMessages.events.listWithParticipant`

Retrieves direct message events for the one-to-one conversation between the authenticated user and a specific participant. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.directMessages.events.listWithParticipant({ participant_id: '2244994945' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|

### media.download

`directMessages.media.download`

Downloads media attached to a legacy Direct Message. The requesting user must be a participant in the conversation containing the specified DM event. The response body contains raw binary bytes. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.directMessages.media.download({ dm_id: '1460323737035677698', media_id: '1460323737035677698', resource_id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `dm_id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `media_id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `resource_id` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contentBase64` | `string` | No | The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set. |
| `text` | `string` | No | The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8. |
| `contentType` | `string` | Yes | Media type of the file, for example application/pdf. |
| `byteLength` | `number` | Yes | Size of the file in bytes. |
| `filename` | `string` | No | The file name, when known. |
| `contentOmitted` | `not_requested \| over_limit` | No | Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit. |
| `fileId` | `string` | No | Where the host saved the file. Over the limit it comes in place of the content; a host that keeps every file sets it beside the content too. On Corsair it is a Files id (fil_…): pass it to another app wherever that app takes a file URL, or read a text file or PDF with files.read_text. |



---

### sendToConversation

`directMessages.sendToConversation`

Sends a new direct message to a specific conversation by its ID. Billed by X: $0.015 per Direct Message. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

### followers.list

`lists.followers.list`

Retrieves a list of Users who follow a specific List by its ID.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.lists.followers.list({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A 64-bit signed integer. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(affiliation \| most_recent_post_id \| pinned_post_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |

### get

`lists.get`

Retrieves details of a specific List by its ID.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.lists.get({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `list.fields` | `(created_at \| description \| follower_count \| id \| member_count \| name \| private)[]` | No | A comma separated list of List fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `owner_id[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |



**Output**

### members.list

### members.remove

`lists.members.remove`

Removes a User from a List by their ID. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.lists.members.remove({ id: '1460323737035677698', user_id: '2244994945' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `user_id` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### posts.list

`lists.posts.list`

Retrieves a list of Posts associated with a specific List by its ID.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.lists.posts.list({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(article.cover_media \| article.media_entities \| attachments.media_keys \| attachments.media_source_tweet \| attachments.poll_ids \| author_id \| edit_history_post_ids \| entities.mentions.username \| geo.place_id \| in_reply_to_user_id \| referenced_posts \| username)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `media.fields` | `(alt_text \| duration_ms \| height \| media_key \| non_public_metrics \| organic_metrics \| preview_image_url \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| revenue \| type \| url \| variants \| width)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Media fields to display. |
| `poll.fields` | `(duration_minutes \| end_datetime \| id \| options \| voting_status)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Poll fields to display. |
| `place.fields` | `(contained_within \| country \| country_code \| full_name \| geo \| id \| name \| place_type)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Place fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### update

`lists.update`

Updates the details of a specific List owned by the authenticated user by its ID. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.lists.update({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `description` | `string` | No | New description for the List (up to 100 characters). |
| `name` | `string` | No | New name for the List (1-25 characters). |
| `private` | `boolean` | No | Whether the List is private. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

## Media

### amplify.addPost

`media.amplify.addPost`

Publishes one of the authenticated user's video posts into one or more active Amplify pre-roll programs the user is enrolled in as a publisher. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope media.library.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.media.amplify.addPost({
	post_id: '1460323737035677698',
	program_ids: ['1460323737035677698'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `blocked_advertiser_ids` | `string[]` | No | Advertiser account ids whose pre-rolls may not run on this post. |
| `post_id` | `string` | Yes | The post to publish. It must belong to the user. |
| `program_ids` | `string[]` | Yes | The programs to publish the post into. |
| `promotion_ends_at` | `string` | No | When promotion of the post ends (ISO 8601). |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### analytics

`media.analytics`

Retrieves analytics data for media. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.media.analytics({
	media_keys: ['3_1460323737035677698'],
	start_time: '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z',
	end_time: '2026-11-02T00:00:00Z',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `media_keys` | `string[]` | Yes | — |
| `start_time` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `end_time` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `granularity` | `hourly \| daily \| total` | No | — |
| `media_analytics.fields` | `(cta_url_clicks \| cta_watch_clicks \| media_key \| play_from_tap \| playback25 \| playback50 \| playback75 \| playback_complete \| playback_start \| timestamp \| timestamped_metrics \| video_views \| watch_time_ms)[]` | No | A comma separated list of MediaAnalytics fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### get

### library.add

`media.library.add`

Adds previously uploaded media to the authenticated user's Media Library with its library metadata. The user must own the media. Geo restrictions, content expiry, the preview image and the audience policy are set with the Media metadata endpoint. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope media.library.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.media.library.add({ media_key: '3_1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `description` | `string` | No | Description shown with the video in the player card. |
| `label` | `string` | No | Label of the item in the library. |
| `media_key` | `string` | Yes | The media key of the uploaded image, GIF or video to add. |
| `monetization` | `object` | No | — |
| `name` | `string` | No | Name of the item in the library. |
| `title` | `string` | No | Title shown with the video in the player card. |

Returns the video categories a publisher can assign to a media library item and the advertiser categories whose ads can be blocked from running against it. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope media.library.read (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.media.library.listCategories({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `lang` | `string` | No | Language tag for category descriptions, e.g. `en` or `pt-BR`. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### library.remove

`media.library.remove`

Removes an item from the authenticated user's Media Library. Posts scheduled through the API that have not yet been published and still use the media are cancelled. Published posts and the underlying media are not affected. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope media.library.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.media.library.remove({ media_key: '3_1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `media_key` | `string` | Yes | The media key of the library item to remove. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### library.update

`media.library.update`

Updates the library metadata of an item in the authenticated user's Media Library. Only the fields sent are changed; the others keep their values. Geo restrictions, content expiry, the preview image and the audience policy are set with the Media metadata endpoint. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope media.library.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.media.library.update({ media_key: '3_1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `media_key` | `string` | Yes | The media key of the library item to update. |
| `description` | `string` | No | Description shown with the video in the player card. |
| `label` | `string` | No | Label of the item in the library. |
| `monetization` | `object` | No | — |
| `name` | `string` | No | Name of the item in the library. |
| `title` | `string` | No | Title shown with the video in the player card. |

### metadata.create

`media.metadata.create`

Creates metadata for a Media file. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts

	id: '1460323737035677698',
	metadata: {},
});
```

### subtitles.create

`media.subtitles.create`

Creates subtitles for a specific Media file. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.media.subtitles.create({
	id: '1460323737035677698',
	media_category: 'AmplifyVideo',
	subtitles: {},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The media id of the video the subtitles belong to. |
| `media_category` | `AmplifyVideo \| TweetVideo` | Yes | The media category of the target media. |
| `subtitles` | `object` | Yes | — |

### upload.append

`media.upload.append`

Appends one segment of the file to a chunked upload. Send the segment base64-encoded in media (raw bytes in multipart bodies) and its position in the file in segment_index, counting from 0. A segment can be up to 8 MB; in a JSON body keep it to 4 MB or less, because base64 adds a third. After the last segment, call Finalize Media Upload. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.media.upload.append({
	id: '1460323737035677698',
	media: { base64: 'iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==', filename: 'pixel.png', contentType: 'image/png' },
	segment_index: 1,
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The upload id from Initialize Media Upload. |
| `media` | `string \| object \| custom` | Yes | One segment of the file: base64-encoded in JSON bodies, raw bytes in multipart bodies. |
| `segment_index` | `number` | Yes | The segment's position in the file, counting from 0. |

```ts
string | {
  url: string,
  filename?: string,

} | {

  contentType?: string
} | custom
```

### upload.finalize

`media.upload.finalize`

Completes a chunked upload once every segment is appended. For video the result carries processing_info: the media can go on a Post only when its state is succeeded, so call Get Media Upload Status until it is. A result without processing_info is ready to use. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.media.upload.finalize({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The upload id from Initialize Media Upload. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### upload.getStatus

`media.upload.getStatus`

Returns how far X has processed an uploaded media file, in processing_info.state: pending, in_progress, succeeded or failed. Call it after Finalize Media Upload returns processing_info, waiting check_after_secs between calls, until the state is succeeded. A failed state means the media can't be used. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.media.upload.getStatus({ media_id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `media_id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `command` | `STATUS` | No | Always STATUS; can be left out. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### upload.initialize

`media.upload.initialize`

Starts a chunked media upload and returns its id. Use it for video and for other files too large for one request. For a video on a Post, set media_category to tweet_video, media_type to the file's type (for example video/mp4) and total_bytes to the file's size. Send the file with Append Media Upload, call Finalize Media Upload, then pass the id in media.media_ids on Create or Edit Post. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.media.upload.initialize({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `additional_owners` | `string[]` | No | User ids granted access to the uploaded media. |
| `media_category` | `amplify_video \| tweet_gif \| tweet_image \| tweet_video \| dm_gif \| dm_image \| dm_video \| subtitles` | No | The media category of the upload. |
| `media_type` | `video/mp4 \| video/webm \| video/mp2t \| video/quicktime \| text/srt \| text/vtt \| image/jpeg \| image/gif \| image/bmp \| image/png \| image/webp \| image/pjpeg \| image/tiff \| model/gltf-binary \| model/vnd.usdz+zip` | No | The type of media. |
| `shared` | `boolean` | No | Whether this media is shared or not. |
| `total_bytes` | `number` | No | The total size of the media upload in bytes. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### upload.single

`media.upload.single`

Uploads a media file in one request and returns its id. Send the file base64-encoded in media (raw bytes in multipart bodies). For a Post, set media_category to tweet_image (JPG, PNG, GIF or WEBP, up to 5 MB) or tweet_gif, then pass the returned id in media.media_ids on Create or Edit Post. DM media uses dm_image or dm_gif. For video, use Initialize Media Upload. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.media.upload.single({
	media: { base64: 'iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==', filename: 'pixel.png', contentType: 'image/png' },
	media_category: 'tweet_image',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `additional_owners` | `string` | No | Comma-separated list of user IDs who can use this media. |
| `media` | `string \| object \| custom` | Yes | The media file to upload: base64-encoded in JSON bodies, raw bytes in multipart bodies. |
| `media_category` | `tweet_image \| tweet_video \| tweet_gif \| dm_image \| dm_video \| dm_gif \| subtitles` | Yes | The category of the media being uploaded. |

```ts
} | {

} | custom
```

### search

`news.search`

Retrieves a list of News stories matching the specified search query.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.news.search({ query: 'from:XDevelopers -is:retweet' });
```

| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |

| `news.fields` | `(category \| cluster_posts_results \| contexts \| disclaimer \| hook \| id \| keywords \| name \| summary \| updated_at)[]` | No | A comma separated list of News fields to display. |

## Posts

### analytics

`posts.analytics`

Retrieves analytics data for specified Posts within a defined time range. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.posts.analytics({
	ids: ['1460323737035677698'],
	start_time: '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z',
	end_time: '2026-11-02T00:00:00Z',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ids` | `string[]` | Yes | — |
| `start_time` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `end_time` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `granularity` | `hourly \| weekly \| daily \| total` | No | — |
| `analytics.fields` | `(app_install_attempts \| app_opens \| bookmarks \| detail_expands \| email_tweet \| engagements \| follows \| hashtag_clicks \| id \| impressions \| likes \| media_views \| permalink_clicks \| quote_tweets \| replies \| retweets \| shares \| timestamp \| timestamped_metrics \| unfollows \| unlikes \| url_clicks \| user_profile_clicks)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Analytics fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### counts.all

`posts.counts.all`

Retrieves the count of Posts matching a search query from the full archive. At most one of `pagination_token`, `next_token` may be provided. Needs app-only auth: X accepts only the app's Bearer token here (connect with authType 'api_key').

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.posts.counts.all({ query: 'from:XDevelopers -is:retweet' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `query` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `start_time` | `string` | No | — |
| `end_time` | `string` | No | — |
| `since_id` | `string` | No | — |
| `until_id` | `string` | No | — |
| `next_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `granularity` | `minute \| hour \| day` | No | — |
| `search_count.fields` | `string` | No | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### counts.recent

`posts.counts.recent`

Retrieves the count of Posts from the last 7 days matching a search query. At most one of `pagination_token`, `next_token` may be provided.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.posts.counts.recent({ query: 'from:XDevelopers -is:retweet' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `query` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `start_time` | `string` | No | Must be within the last 7 days. |
| `end_time` | `string` | No | — |
| `since_id` | `string` | No | — |
| `until_id` | `string` | No | — |
| `next_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `granularity` | `minute \| hour \| day` | No | — |
| `search_count.fields` | `string` | No | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### create

`posts.create`

Creates a new Post for the authenticated user, or edits an existing Post when edit_options are provided. Media in media.media_ids is attached in the order given; get the ids by uploading each image with Upload Media, or a video with Initialize Media Upload. Supports paid partnership disclosure via the paid_partnership field. Billed by X: $0.015 per post, $0.20 for a post that contains a URL. Quote posts (quote_tweet_id): X removed this from the self-serve pay-per-use tiers on 2026-04-20, so it may answer 403 unless the app has an enterprise or legacy tier. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.posts.create({ text: 'Shipping the new release today.' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `card_uri` | `string` | No | Card URI parameter. |
| `clip` | `object` | No | — |
| `community_id` | `string` | No | Community to post the tweet to. |
| `direct_message_deep_link` | `string` | No | Direct message deep link. |
| `edit_options` | `object` | No | — |
| `for_super_followers_only` | `boolean` | No | Restrict tweet to super followers. |
| `geo` | `object` | No | — |
| `made_with_ai` | `boolean` | No | Disclose that the tweet contains AI-generated media. |
| `media` | `object` | No | — |
| `nullcast` | `boolean` | No | If true, the tweet is not shown in the public timeline. |
| `paid_partnership` | `boolean` | No | Disclose that the tweet is a paid partnership. |
| `poll` | `object` | No | — |
| `quote_tweet_id` | `string` | No | Tweet ID to quote. |
| `reply` | `object` | No | — |
| `reply_settings` | `following \| mentionedUsers \| subscribers \| verified` | No | Who can reply to this tweet. |
| `share_with_followers` | `boolean` | No | Share an exclusive (super-follower) tweet with all followers. |
| `text` | `string` | No | Text of the Post. Required unless media is provided. At most 280 characters unless the account has X Premium. |

### drafts.create

`posts.drafts.create`

Saves a Post draft to the authenticated user's X account without publishing it. Takes the body of Create or Edit Post, of which a draft stores text, media with tagged users, a reply and the AI and paid partnership disclosures. Any other field that is set is a 400 that names it. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.posts.drafts.create({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `card_uri` | `string` | No | Card URI parameter. |
| `clip` | `object` | No | — |
| `community_id` | `string` | No | Community to post the tweet to. |
| `direct_message_deep_link` | `string` | No | Direct message deep link. |
| `edit_options` | `object` | No | — |
| `for_super_followers_only` | `boolean` | No | Restrict tweet to super followers. |
| `geo` | `object` | No | — |
| `made_with_ai` | `boolean` | No | Disclose that the tweet contains AI-generated media. |
| `media` | `object` | No | — |
| `nullcast` | `boolean` | No | If true, the tweet is not shown in the public timeline. |
| `paid_partnership` | `boolean` | No | Disclose that the tweet is a paid partnership. |
| `poll` | `object` | No | — |
| `quote_tweet_id` | `string` | No | Tweet ID to quote. |
| `reply` | `object` | No | — |
| `reply_settings` | `following \| mentionedUsers \| subscribers \| verified` | No | Who can reply to this tweet. |
| `share_with_followers` | `boolean` | No | Share an exclusive (super-follower) tweet with all followers. |
| `text` | `string` | No | Text of the Post. Required unless media is provided. At most 280 characters unless the account has X Premium. |

### drafts.delete

`posts.drafts.delete`

Deletes one of the authenticated user's Post drafts by its ID. The whole draft is deleted, including any part Get Post Drafts does not list, and cannot be restored. An ID that is not one of the user's drafts also returns deleted: true. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.posts.drafts.delete({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the draft to delete. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### drafts.list

`posts.drafts.list`

Returns the authenticated user's Post drafts, newest first, in the fields of the Create or Edit Post body. thread holds the Posts after the first. A draft with unsupported_content is not listed in full: do not publish it from this list or delete it unless the user asks. Needs the tweet.write scope. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.posts.drafts.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `max_results` | `number` | No | The maximum number of drafts to return. |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | The meta.next_token of the previous page. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### get

`posts.get`

Retrieves details of a specific Post by its ID.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.posts.get({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(article.cover_media \| article.media_entities \| attachments.media_keys \| attachments.media_source_tweet \| attachments.poll_ids \| author_id \| edit_history_post_ids \| entities.mentions.username \| geo.place_id \| in_reply_to_user_id \| referenced_posts \| username)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `media.fields` | `(alt_text \| duration_ms \| height \| media_key \| non_public_metrics \| organic_metrics \| preview_image_url \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| revenue \| type \| url \| variants \| width)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Media fields to display. |
| `poll.fields` | `(duration_minutes \| end_datetime \| id \| options \| voting_status)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Poll fields to display. |
| `place.fields` | `(contained_within \| country \| country_code \| full_name \| geo \| id \| name \| place_type)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Place fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |

---

### getMany

`posts.getMany`

Retrieves details of multiple Posts by their IDs.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.posts.getMany({
	ids: ['1460323737035677698'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ids` | `string[]` | Yes | — |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(article.cover_media \| article.media_entities \| attachments.media_keys \| attachments.media_source_tweet \| attachments.poll_ids \| author_id \| edit_history_post_ids \| entities.mentions.username \| geo.place_id \| in_reply_to_user_id \| referenced_posts \| username)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `media.fields` | `(alt_text \| duration_ms \| height \| media_key \| non_public_metrics \| organic_metrics \| preview_image_url \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| revenue \| type \| url \| variants \| width)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Media fields to display. |
| `poll.fields` | `(duration_minutes \| end_datetime \| id \| options \| voting_status)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Poll fields to display. |
| `place.fields` | `(contained_within \| country \| country_code \| full_name \| geo \| id \| name \| place_type)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Place fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### hideReply

`posts.hideReply`

Hides or unhides a reply to a conversation owned by the authenticated user. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.posts.hideReply({ tweet_id: '1460323737035677698', hidden: true });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `tweet_id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `hidden` | `boolean` | Yes | Whether the reply should be hidden. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### likingUsers

`posts.likingUsers`

Retrieves a list of Users who liked a specific Post by its ID. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.posts.likingUsers({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(affiliation \| most_recent_post_id \| pinned_post_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

---

### quotes

`posts.quotes`

Retrieves a list of Posts that quote a specific Post by its ID.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.posts.quotes({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `exclude` | `(replies \| retweets)[]` | No | — |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(article.cover_media \| article.media_entities \| attachments.media_keys \| attachments.media_source_tweet \| attachments.poll_ids \| author_id \| edit_history_post_ids \| entities.mentions.username \| geo.place_id \| in_reply_to_user_id \| referenced_posts \| username)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `media.fields` | `(alt_text \| duration_ms \| height \| media_key \| non_public_metrics \| organic_metrics \| preview_image_url \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| revenue \| type \| url \| variants \| width)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Media fields to display. |
| `poll.fields` | `(duration_minutes \| end_datetime \| id \| options \| voting_status)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Poll fields to display. |
| `place.fields` | `(contained_within \| country \| country_code \| full_name \| geo \| id \| name \| place_type)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Place fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### repostedBy

`posts.repostedBy`

Retrieves a list of Users who reposted a specific Post by its ID.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.posts.repostedBy({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(affiliation \| most_recent_post_id \| pinned_post_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |

---

### reposts

`posts.reposts`

Retrieves a list of Posts that repost a specific Post by its ID.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.posts.reposts({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(article.cover_media \| article.media_entities \| attachments.media_keys \| attachments.media_source_tweet \| attachments.poll_ids \| author_id \| edit_history_post_ids \| entities.mentions.username \| geo.place_id \| in_reply_to_user_id \| referenced_posts \| username)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `media.fields` | `(alt_text \| duration_ms \| height \| media_key \| non_public_metrics \| organic_metrics \| preview_image_url \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| revenue \| type \| url \| variants \| width)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Media fields to display. |
| `poll.fields` | `(duration_minutes \| end_datetime \| id \| options \| voting_status)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Poll fields to display. |
| `place.fields` | `(contained_within \| country \| country_code \| full_name \| geo \| id \| name \| place_type)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Place fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |
