---

### search.all

`posts.search.all`

Retrieves Posts from the full archive matching a search query. At most one of `start_time`, `since_id` may be provided. At most one of `end_time`, `until_id` may be provided. At most one of `pagination_token`, `next_token` may be provided. Billed by X per post returned ($0.005 each); keep max_results low.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.posts.search.all({ query: 'from:XDevelopers -is:retweet' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `query` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `start_time` | `string` | No | — |
| `end_time` | `string` | No | — |
| `since_id` | `string` | No | — |
| `until_id` | `string` | No | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `next_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `sort_order` | `recency \| relevancy` | No | — |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(article.cover_media \| article.media_entities \| attachments.media_keys \| attachments.media_source_tweet \| attachments.poll_ids \| author_id \| edit_history_post_ids \| entities.mentions.username \| geo.place_id \| in_reply_to_user_id \| referenced_posts \| username)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `media.fields` | `(alt_text \| duration_ms \| height \| media_key \| non_public_metrics \| organic_metrics \| preview_image_url \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| revenue \| type \| url \| variants \| width)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Media fields to display. |
| `poll.fields` | `(duration_minutes \| end_datetime \| id \| options \| voting_status)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Poll fields to display. |
| `place.fields` | `(contained_within \| country \| country_code \| full_name \| geo \| id \| name \| place_type)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Place fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

---

### search.recent

`posts.search.recent`

Retrieves Posts from the last 7 days matching a search query. At most one of `start_time`, `since_id` may be provided. At most one of `end_time`, `until_id` may be provided. At most one of `pagination_token`, `next_token` may be provided. Billed by X per post returned ($0.005 each); keep max_results low.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.posts.search.recent({
	query: 'from:XDevelopers -is:retweet',
	max_results: 10,
	post.fields: ['created_at', 'public_metrics'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `query` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `next_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `start_time` | `string` | No | Must be within the last 7 days. |
| `end_time` | `string` | No | — |
| `since_id` | `string` | No | — |
| `until_id` | `string` | No | — |
| `sort_order` | `recency \| relevancy` | No | — |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(article.cover_media \| article.media_entities \| attachments.media_keys \| attachments.media_source_tweet \| attachments.poll_ids \| author_id \| edit_history_post_ids \| entities.mentions.username \| geo.place_id \| in_reply_to_user_id \| referenced_posts \| username)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `media.fields` | `(alt_text \| duration_ms \| height \| media_key \| non_public_metrics \| organic_metrics \| preview_image_url \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| revenue \| type \| url \| variants \| width)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Media fields to display. |
| `poll.fields` | `(duration_minutes \| end_datetime \| id \| options \| voting_status)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Poll fields to display. |
| `place.fields` | `(contained_within \| country \| country_code \| full_name \| geo \| id \| name \| place_type)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Place fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

---

### streamLinks.create

`posts.streamLinks.create`

Creates a link to deliver FilteredStream events to the given webhook. Needs app-only auth: X accepts only the app's Bearer token here (connect with authType 'api_key').

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.posts.streamLinks.create({ webhook_id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `webhook_id` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### streamRules.list

`posts.streamRules.list`

Returns the active filtered-stream rules for the authenticated app. Provide `ids` to fetch specific rules; omit it to list all rules. Needs app-only auth: X accepts only the app's Bearer token here (connect with authType 'api_key').

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.posts.streamRules.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ids` | `string[]` | No | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token that decodes to 8 bytes. |

### streamRules.update

`posts.streamRules.update`

Adds or deletes rules from the active rule set for the filtered stream. Exactly one of `add`, `delete`, or `?delete_all=true` must be specified. Use `?dry_run=true` to validate without committing. Needs app-only auth: X accepts only the app's Bearer token here (connect with authType 'api_key').

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.posts.streamRules.update({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `dry_run` | `boolean` | No | — |
| `delete_all` | `boolean` | No | — |
| `add` | `object[]` | No | Rules to add. |
| `delete` | `object` | No | — |

## Sources

### create

`sources.create`

Creates a persistent RTMP/RTMPS ingest point for the authenticated user. Push an encoder to `rtmps_url` with the returned `stream_key`. This is the only response that includes the stream key; read it later with GET /2/sources/:id/stream_key. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read, broadcast.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.sources.create({ name: 'Launch week', region: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | `string` | Yes | Label for the source. |
| `region` | `string` | Yes | Ingest region, as returned by GET /2/region. us-west-1 and us-west-2 ingest in US West; us-east-1, us-east-2, ca-central-1, sa-east-1, eu-west-1, eu-west-2, eu-west-3, eu-central-1, eu-north-1, ap-south-1, ap-northeast-1, ap-northeast-2, ap-southeast-1 and ap-southeast-2 ingest in US East. The response's `region` is the serving location (`us-east-1` or `us-west-2`). |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### get

`sources.get`

Returns one of the authenticated user's stream sources. Poll it after starting an encoder and wait for `is_stream_active` before going live. The stream key is not included; read it with GET /2/sources/:id/stream_key. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.sources.get({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

### getIngestRegion

`sources.getIngestRegion`

Returns the ingest region nearest the server handling the request. Pass it as `region` when creating a stream source to ingest there. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.sources.getIngestRegion({});
```

**Input:** _empty object_


**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `region` | `string \| null` | No | Ingest region. Pass it as `region` when creating a stream source. |



---

### getStreamKey

`sources.getStreamKey`

Returns the stream key of one of the authenticated user's stream sources. The stream key is a credential: anyone with it can stream to the source, so keep it out of logs, URLs and client-side code. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read, broadcast.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.sources.getStreamKey({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Source id (19 digits), from GET /2/sources. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

```ts
} | null
```

### list

`sources.list`

Returns the authenticated user's RTMP/RTMPS stream sources. A source's `id` is the `source_id` that POST /2/broadcasts and scheduled broadcasts take. Stream keys are not included; read one with GET /2/sources/:id/stream_key. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.sources.list({});
```

**Input:** _empty object_


**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### rename

`sources.rename`

Renames one of the authenticated user's stream sources. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read, broadcast.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.sources.rename({ id: '1460323737035677698', name: 'Launch week' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Source id (19 digits), from GET /2/sources. |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | New label for the source. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

## Spaces

### get

`spaces.get`

Retrieves details of a specific Space by its ID.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.spaces.get({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `space.fields` | `(created_at \| ended_at \| id \| is_ticketed \| lang \| participant_count \| scheduled_start \| started_at \| state \| subscriber_count \| title \| updated_at)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Space fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(creator_id \| host_ids \| invited_user_ids \| speaker_ids \| topic_ids)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `topic.fields` | `(description \| id \| name)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Topic fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |

---

### getByCreators

`spaces.getByCreators`

Retrieves details of Spaces created by specified User IDs.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.spaces.getByCreators({
	user_ids: ['2244994945'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `user_ids` | `string[]` | Yes | — |
| `space.fields` | `(created_at \| ended_at \| id \| is_ticketed \| lang \| participant_count \| scheduled_start \| started_at \| state \| subscriber_count \| title \| updated_at)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Space fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(creator_id \| host_ids \| invited_user_ids \| speaker_ids \| topic_ids)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `topic.fields` | `(description \| id \| name)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Topic fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

---

### getMany

`spaces.getMany`

Retrieves details of multiple Spaces by their IDs.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.spaces.getMany({
	ids: ['1460323737035677698'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ids` | `string[]` | Yes | — |
| `space.fields` | `(created_at \| ended_at \| id \| is_ticketed \| lang \| participant_count \| scheduled_start \| started_at \| state \| subscriber_count \| title \| updated_at)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Space fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(creator_id \| host_ids \| invited_user_ids \| speaker_ids \| topic_ids)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `topic.fields` | `(description \| id \| name)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Topic fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### listBuyers

`spaces.listBuyers`

Retrieves a list of Users who purchased tickets to a specific Space by its ID. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.spaces.listBuyers({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(affiliation \| most_recent_post_id \| pinned_post_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### listPosts

`spaces.listPosts`

Retrieves a list of Posts shared in a specific Space by its ID.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.spaces.listPosts({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(article.cover_media \| article.media_entities \| attachments.media_keys \| attachments.media_source_tweet \| attachments.poll_ids \| author_id \| edit_history_post_ids \| entities.mentions.username \| geo.place_id \| in_reply_to_user_id \| referenced_posts \| username)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `media.fields` | `(alt_text \| duration_ms \| height \| media_key \| non_public_metrics \| organic_metrics \| preview_image_url \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| revenue \| type \| url \| variants \| width)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Media fields to display. |
| `poll.fields` | `(duration_minutes \| end_datetime \| id \| options \| voting_status)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Poll fields to display. |
| `place.fields` | `(contained_within \| country \| country_code \| full_name \| geo \| id \| name \| place_type)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Place fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

---

### search

`spaces.search`

Retrieves a list of Spaces matching the specified search query.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.spaces.search({ query: 'from:XDevelopers -is:retweet' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `query` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `state` | `live \| scheduled \| all` | No | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `space.fields` | `(created_at \| ended_at \| id \| is_ticketed \| lang \| participant_count \| scheduled_start \| started_at \| state \| subscriber_count \| title \| updated_at)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Space fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(creator_id \| host_ids \| invited_user_ids \| speaker_ids \| topic_ids)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `topic.fields` | `(description \| id \| name)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Topic fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

## Trends

### byWoeid

`trends.byWoeid`

Retrieves trending topics for a specific location identified by its WOEID. `meta.location` describes that location: its `woeid` and `name`, and when they are known its `country`, `country_code`, `place_type` (`town`, `country` or `supername`) and `parent_id`, the WOEID of the place that contains it.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.trends.byWoeid({ woeid: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `woeid` | `number` | Yes | — |
| `max_trends` | `number` | No | — |
| `trend.fields` | `(trend_name \| tweet_count)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Trend fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### locations

`trends.locations`

Retrieves every location that has trends. Each location has a WOEID to pass to `GET /2/trends/by/woeid/{woeid}`. The list is short and is returned whole, so the route takes no paging parameters.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.trends.locations({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `trend_location.fields` | `(country \| country_code \| name \| parent_id \| place_type \| woeid)[]` | No | A comma separated list of TrendLocation fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

## Tweets

### create

`tweets.create`

Publish a post on X as the connected user (camelCase inputs; posts.create takes X's own fields). Billed by X: $0.015 per post, $0.20 for a post that contains a URL.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.tweets.create({ text: 'Shipping the new release today.' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `text` | `string` | Yes | Post text (up to 280 weighted characters) |
| `quoteTweetId` | `string` | No | ID of the post to quote. X removed quote posts from the self-serve tiers on 2026-04-20, so this may answer 403. |
| `mediaIds` | `string[]` | No | Up to 4 media IDs to attach (from media.upload.*) |
| `replySettings` | `following \| mentionedUsers \| subscribers` | No | Restricts who can reply to this post |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
  id: string,
  text: string
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



---

### createReply

`tweets.createReply`

Reply to a post on X as the connected user. Billed by X: $0.015 per post, $0.20 for a post that contains a URL.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.tweets.createReply({ text: 'Thanks for the report, fixed in 1.2.1.', inReplyToTweetId: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `text` | `string` | Yes | Reply text (up to 280 weighted characters) |
| `inReplyToTweetId` | `string` | Yes | ID of the post to reply to |
| `excludeReplyUserIds` | `string[]` | No | User IDs to leave out of the reply's @mentions |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
  id: string,
  text: string
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Usage

### credits

`usage.credits`

Returns the payer's developer-platform credit balance in USD. total_balance is max(0, prepaid_balance + free_balance); prepaid_balance may be negative.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.usage.credits({});
```

**Input:** _empty object_


**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### get

`usage.get`

Retrieves usage statistics for Posts over a specified number of days. Needs app-only auth: X accepts only the app's Bearer token here (connect with authType 'api_key').

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.usage.get({ days: 7 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `days` | `number` | No | — |
| `usage.fields` | `(cap_reset_day \| daily_client_app_usage \| daily_project_usage \| project_cap \| project_id \| project_usage)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Usage fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

## Users

### affiliates

`users.affiliates`

Retrieves a list of Users who are affiliated with a specific organization User by their ID.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.affiliates({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A 64-bit signed integer. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(affiliation \| most_recent_post_id \| pinned_post_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |



**Output**

|------|------|----------|-------------|

| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### blocking.block

`users.blocking.block`

Causes the source User to block the target User. A block also removes any follow between the two Users, in both directions, and unblocking does not restore it. Each call blocks one account: block only accounts the authenticated User named or approved, because finding or reviewing accounts is not approval to block them. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.blocking.block({ id: '1460323737035677698', target_user_id: '2244994945' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `target_user_id` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

```ts
} | null
```

### blocking.unblock

Causes the source User to unblock the target User. Unblocking does not restore any follow the block removed, so blocking and then unblocking a follower removes them as a follower: do that only for followers the authenticated User approved removing. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.blocking.unblock({ source_user_id: '2244994945', target_user_id: '2244994945' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `source_user_id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `target_user_id` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### bookmarks.create

`users.bookmarks.create`

Adds one or more Posts to the authenticated user's Bookmarks. Supply `tweet_id` for a single Post, or `tweet_ids` (at most 25) to bookmark several in one request. Optional `folder_id` applies to every Post in the request. Billing and rate limits still apply per HTTP request. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.bookmarks.create({ id: '1460323737035677698', tweet_id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `folder_id` | `string` | No | Optional ID of the Bookmark folder to add the Post(s) to. When omitted, Posts are added to the user's top-level Bookmarks only. A bulk request uses this one folder for every ID. |
| `tweet_id` | `string` | No | The ID of the Post to add to the user's Bookmarks. Mutually exclusive with `tweet_ids`. |
| `tweet_ids` | `string[]` | No | Post IDs to add to the user's Bookmarks. At most 25. Mutually exclusive with `tweet_id`. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  data?: {
    bookmarked?: boolean | null
  } | null
} | {
  data?: {
    bookmarked?: boolean | null,
    tweet_id?: string | null
  }[] | null,
  errors?: {
    detail?: string | null,
    title?: string | null,
    tweet_id?: string | null
  }[] | null
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### broadcasts.create

`users.broadcasts.create`

Creates a broadcast on one of the authenticated user's sources. `id` must be the authenticated user. The broadcast is `NOT_STARTED` and posts nothing until it is published with PUT /2/users/:id/broadcasts/:broadcast_id/state; one that is never published is deleted after 7 days. When the source already has a running broadcast, that broadcast is returned. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read, broadcast.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.broadcasts.create({ id: '1460323737035677698', source_id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `is_low_latency` | `boolean \| string \| number` | No | Ignored. |
| `region` | `string` | No | Ignored: the source sets the region. |
| `source_id` | `string` | Yes | The source's `rtmp_stream_key`. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### broadcasts.list

`users.broadcasts.list`

Returns the authenticated user's broadcasts, 100 per page. `id` must be the authenticated user. Deprecated: use GET /2/broadcasts. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.broadcasts.list({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | `next_token.offset` from the previous page. Empty reads the first page. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### broadcasts.updateState

`users.broadcasts.updateState`

Publishes or ends one of the authenticated user's broadcasts. `id` must be the authenticated user. `PUBLISH` takes a broadcast created with POST /2/users/:id/broadcasts live once its source is receiving video, and posts it unless `should_not_tweet` is true. `END` ends the broadcast. Deprecated: use PUT /2/broadcasts/:id/state to end a broadcast. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read, broadcast.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.broadcasts.updateState({ id: '1460323737035677698', broadcast_id: '1460323737035677698', state: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `broadcast_id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `chat_option` | `number \| string` | No | Who can chat: 0 default, 1 chat off, 2 everyone, 3 verified accounts, 4 accounts the host follows, 5 the host's subscribers, 6 accounts followed by an account the host follows. A numeric string is also accepted. `PUBLISH` only. |
| `locale` | `string` | No | Broadcast language. `PUBLISH` only. |
| `should_not_tweet` | `boolean \| string \| number` | No | Skip the announcing Post. Unset keeps the broadcast's setting, which defaults to posting. `"true"`, `"false"`, `1` and `0` are also accepted. `PUBLISH` only. |
| `state` | `string` | Yes | `PUBLISH` or `END`. |
| `title` | `string` | No | Broadcast title. `PUBLISH` only. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

| `expansions` | `owner_id[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |

### followers

`users.followers`

Retrieves a list of Users who follow a specific User by their ID.

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.followers({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | The maximum number of users to return. |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | The next_token or previous_token from a previous response, to fetch that page. A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |

| `expansions` | `(affiliation \| most_recent_post_id \| pinned_post_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |

### following.follow

`users.following.follow`

Causes the authenticated user to follow a specific User by their ID. X removed this from the self-serve pay-per-use tiers on 2026-04-20, so it may answer 403 unless the app has an enterprise or legacy tier. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.following.follow({ id: '1460323737035677698', target_user_id: '2244994945' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `target_user_id` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### following.list

`users.following.list`

Retrieves a list of Users followed by a specific User by their ID.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.following.list({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | The maximum number of users to return. |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | The next_token or previous_token from a previous response, to fetch that page. A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(affiliation \| most_recent_post_id \| pinned_post_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### following.unfollow

`users.following.unfollow`

Causes the authenticated user to unfollow a specific user by their ID. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`


### get

---

### getByUsername

`users.getByUsername`

Retrieves details of a specific User by their username. Billed by X as one user read ($0.010).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.getByUsername({
	username: 'XDevelopers',
	user.fields: ['description', 'public_metrics'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `username` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(affiliation \| most_recent_post_id \| pinned_post_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |

---

### getMany

`users.getMany`

Retrieves details of multiple Users by their IDs.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.getMany({
	ids: ['1460323737035677698'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ids` | `string[]` | Yes | — |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(affiliation \| most_recent_post_id \| pinned_post_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### getManyByUsernames

`users.getManyByUsernames`

Retrieves details of multiple Users by their usernames.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.getManyByUsernames({
	usernames: ['XDevelopers'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `usernames` | `string[]` | Yes | — |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(affiliation \| most_recent_post_id \| pinned_post_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |

---

### likes.like

`users.likes.like`

Causes the authenticated user to like a specific Post by its ID. X removed this from the self-serve pay-per-use tiers on 2026-04-20, so it may answer 403 unless the app has an enterprise or legacy tier. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.likes.like({ id: '1460323737035677698', tweet_id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `tweet_id` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### likes.list

`users.likes.list`

Retrieves a list of Posts liked by a specific User by their ID. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.likes.list({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(article.cover_media \| article.media_entities \| attachments.media_keys \| attachments.media_source_tweet \| attachments.poll_ids \| author_id \| edit_history_post_ids \| entities.mentions.username \| geo.place_id \| in_reply_to_user_id \| referenced_posts \| username)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `media.fields` | `(alt_text \| duration_ms \| height \| media_key \| non_public_metrics \| organic_metrics \| preview_image_url \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| revenue \| type \| url \| variants \| width)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Media fields to display. |
| `poll.fields` | `(duration_minutes \| end_datetime \| id \| options \| voting_status)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Poll fields to display. |
| `place.fields` | `(contained_within \| country \| country_code \| full_name \| geo \| id \| name \| place_type)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Place fields to display. |

---

### me

`users.me`

Get the user the access token belongs to (id, name, username). Billed by X as one user read ($0.010). Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.me({
	user.fields: ['created_at', 'public_metrics', 'verified'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(affiliation \| most_recent_post_id \| pinned_post_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |

---

### mentions

`users.mentions`

Retrieves a list of Posts that mention a specific User by their ID. When both are provided, `start_time` must be earlier than `end_time`. When both are provided, `since_id` must be less than `until_id`.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.mentions({ id: '2244994945', max_results: 10 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `start_time` | `string` | No | Must be on or after 2010-11-06. |
| `end_time` | `string` | No | Must be on or after 2010-11-06. |
| `since_id` | `string` | No | — |
| `until_id` | `string` | No | — |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(article.cover_media \| article.media_entities \| attachments.media_keys \| attachments.media_source_tweet \| attachments.poll_ids \| author_id \| edit_history_post_ids \| entities.mentions.username \| geo.place_id \| in_reply_to_user_id \| referenced_posts \| username)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `media.fields` | `(alt_text \| duration_ms \| height \| media_key \| non_public_metrics \| organic_metrics \| preview_image_url \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| revenue \| type \| url \| variants \| width)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Media fields to display. |
| `poll.fields` | `(duration_minutes \| end_datetime \| id \| options \| voting_status)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Poll fields to display. |
| `place.fields` | `(contained_within \| country \| country_code \| full_name \| geo \| id \| name \| place_type)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Place fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

---

### muting.list

`users.muting.list`

Retrieves a list of Users muted by the authenticated user. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.muting.list({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | — |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(affiliation \| most_recent_post_id \| pinned_post_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### myFollowers

`users.myFollowers`

Returns the Users who follow the authenticated user. Same results as `GET /2/users/{id}/followers` with your own user ID, without looking it up. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.myFollowers({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `max_results` | `number` | No | The maximum number of users to return. |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | The next_token or previous_token from a previous response, to fetch that page. A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(affiliation \| most_recent_post_id \| pinned_post_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

---

### myFollowing

`users.myFollowing`

Returns the Users the authenticated user follows. Same results as `GET /2/users/{id}/following` with your own user ID, without looking it up. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.myFollowing({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `max_results` | `number` | No | The maximum number of users to return. |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | The next_token or previous_token from a previous response, to fetch that page. A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(affiliation \| most_recent_post_id \| pinned_post_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### ownedLists

`users.ownedLists`

Retrieves a list of Lists owned by a specific User by their ID.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.ownedLists({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A 64-bit signed integer. |
| `list.fields` | `(created_at \| description \| follower_count \| id \| member_count \| name \| private)[]` | No | A comma separated list of List fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `owner_id[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |



**Output**

|------|------|----------|-------------|

### pinnedLists.list

`users.pinnedLists.list`

Retrieves a list of Lists pinned by the authenticated user. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.pinnedLists.list({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

### pinnedLists.pin

`users.pinnedLists.pin`

Causes the authenticated user to pin a specific List by its ID. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

### posts

`users.posts`

Retrieves a list of Posts authored by a specific User by their ID. When both are provided, `start_time` must be earlier than `end_time`. When both are provided, `since_id` must be less than `until_id`.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.posts({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `start_time` | `string` | No | Must be on or after 2010-11-06. |
| `end_time` | `string` | No | Must be on or after 2010-11-06. |
| `since_id` | `string` | No | — |
| `until_id` | `string` | No | — |
| `exclude` | `(replies \| retweets)[]` | No | — |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(article.cover_media \| article.media_entities \| attachments.media_keys \| attachments.media_source_tweet \| attachments.poll_ids \| author_id \| edit_history_post_ids \| entities.mentions.username \| geo.place_id \| in_reply_to_user_id \| referenced_posts \| username)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `media.fields` | `(alt_text \| duration_ms \| height \| media_key \| non_public_metrics \| organic_metrics \| preview_image_url \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| revenue \| type \| url \| variants \| width)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Media fields to display. |
| `poll.fields` | `(duration_minutes \| end_datetime \| id \| options \| voting_status)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Poll fields to display. |
| `place.fields` | `(contained_within \| country \| country_code \| full_name \| geo \| id \| name \| place_type)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Place fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### publicKeys.add

`users.publicKeys.add`

Registers a user's public key for X Chat encryption. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.publicKeys.add({
	id: '1460323737035677698',
	public_key: {},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `public_key` | `object` | Yes | — |

### publicKeys.get

`users.publicKeys.get`

Returns a user's registered public keys for X Chat encryption. Every key field is returned by default, so public_key.fields can be left out. It takes public_key, signing_public_key, identity_public_key_signature, public_key_version and juicebox_config. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.publicKeys.get({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `public_key.fields` | `(identity_public_key_signature \| juicebox_config \| public_key \| public_key_version \| signing_public_key \| user_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of PublicKey fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### publicKeys.getMany

`users.publicKeys.getMany`

Returns the public keys that up to 100 users registered for X Chat encryption, looked up by numeric user ID. Each key carries the user_id of the user it belongs to. Every key field is returned by default, so public_key.fields can be left out. It takes public_key, signing_public_key, identity_public_key_signature, public_key_version, juicebox_config and user_id. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.publicKeys.getMany({
	ids: ['1460323737035677698'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ids` | `string[]` | Yes | Comma-separated numeric user IDs (1-100), not @usernames. |
| `public_key.fields` | `(identity_public_key_signature \| juicebox_config \| public_key \| public_key_version \| signing_public_key \| user_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of PublicKey fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

```ts
}[] | null
```

### repostsOfMe

`users.repostsOfMe`

Retrieves a list of Posts that repost content from the authenticated user. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope timeline.read (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.repostsOfMe({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(article.cover_media \| article.media_entities \| attachments.media_keys \| attachments.media_source_tweet \| attachments.poll_ids \| author_id \| edit_history_post_ids \| entities.mentions.username \| geo.place_id \| in_reply_to_user_id \| referenced_posts \| username)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `media.fields` | `(alt_text \| duration_ms \| height \| media_key \| non_public_metrics \| organic_metrics \| preview_image_url \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| revenue \| type \| url \| variants \| width)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Media fields to display. |
| `poll.fields` | `(duration_minutes \| end_datetime \| id \| options \| voting_status)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Poll fields to display. |
| `place.fields` | `(contained_within \| country \| country_code \| full_name \| geo \| id \| name \| place_type)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Place fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

---

### search

`users.search`

Retrieves a list of Users matching a search query.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.search({ query: 'XDevelopers', max_results: 10 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `query` | `string` | Yes | A name or @username (1-50 chars): letters and digits in any language, spaces, and _ ' . - @ & " |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `next_token` | `string` | No | — |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(affiliation \| most_recent_post_id \| pinned_post_id)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |

---

### sources.create

`users.sources.create`

Creates a persistent RTMP/RTMPS ingest point for the authenticated user. `id` must be the authenticated user. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read, broadcast.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.sources.create({ id: '1460323737035677698', name: 'Launch week' });
```

**Input**

### sources.delete

### sources.list

`users.sources.list`

Returns the authenticated user's RTMP/RTMPS stream sources (empty array if none). `id` must be the authenticated user. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.sources.list({ id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### sources.rename

`users.sources.rename`

Renames one of the authenticated user's stream sources. `id` must be the authenticated user. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token. Needs the extra OAuth scope broadcast.read, broadcast.write (pass scopes to the plugin).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.sources.rename({ id: '1460323737035677698', source_id: '1460323737035677698', name: 'Launch week' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `source_id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | New label for the source. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

---

### timeline

`users.timeline`

Retrieves a reverse chronological list of Posts in the authenticated user's Timeline. When both are provided, `start_time` must be earlier than `end_time`. When both are provided, `since_id` must be less than `until_id`. Needs a user (OAuth 2.0) token.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.users.timeline({ id: '2244994945', max_results: 10 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `max_results` | `number` | No | — |
| `pagination_token` | `string` | No | A base32hex-encoded pagination token. |
| `start_time` | `string` | No | Must be on or after 2010-11-06. |
| `end_time` | `string` | No | Must be on or after 2010-11-06. |
| `since_id` | `string` | No | — |
| `until_id` | `string` | No | — |
| `exclude` | `(replies \| retweets)[]` | No | — |
| `post.fields` | `(article \| article_title \| attachments \| card_uri \| community_id \| context_annotations \| conversation_id \| created_at \| display_text_range \| edit_controls \| entities \| geo \| id \| lang \| matched_media_notes \| media_metadata \| non_public_metrics \| note_post \| note_request_suggestions \| organic_metrics \| paid_partnership \| possibly_sensitive \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| reply_settings \| scopes \| source \| suggested_source_links \| suggested_source_links_with_counts \| text \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Post fields to display. |
| `expansions` | `(article.cover_media \| article.media_entities \| attachments.media_keys \| attachments.media_source_tweet \| attachments.poll_ids \| author_id \| edit_history_post_ids \| entities.mentions.username \| geo.place_id \| in_reply_to_user_id \| referenced_posts \| username)[]` | No | A comma separated list of fields to expand. |
| `user.fields` | `(active_follower_count \| confirmed_email \| connection_status \| created_at \| description \| entities \| id \| is_identity_verified \| location \| name \| org_only \| parody \| profile_banner_url \| profile_image_url \| protected \| public_metrics \| receives_your_chat \| receives_your_dm \| subscriber_count \| subscribes_to_you \| subscription \| subscription_type \| url \| username \| verified \| verified_followers_count \| verified_type \| withheld)[]` | No | A comma separated list of User fields to display. |
| `media.fields` | `(alt_text \| duration_ms \| height \| media_key \| non_public_metrics \| organic_metrics \| preview_image_url \| promoted_metrics \| public_metrics \| revenue \| type \| url \| variants \| width)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Media fields to display. |
| `poll.fields` | `(duration_minutes \| end_datetime \| id \| options \| voting_status)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Poll fields to display. |
| `place.fields` | `(contained_within \| country \| country_code \| full_name \| geo \| id \| name \| place_type)[]` | No | A comma separated list of Place fields to display. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includes` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `meta` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### list

`webhooks.list`

Get a list of webhook configs associated with a client app.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.webhooks.list({});
```

### replay

`webhooks.replay`

Creates a replay job to retrieve events from up to the past 24 hours for all events delivered or attempted to be delivered to the webhook. Needs app-only auth: X accepts only the app's Bearer token here (connect with authType 'api_key').

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.webhooks.replay({ webhook_id: '1460323737035677698', from_date: '123456789012', to_date: '123456789012' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `from_date` | `string` | Yes | The oldest (inclusive) UTC timestamp from which events are replayed, in yyyymmddhhmm format. |
| `to_date` | `string` | Yes | The newest (inclusive) UTC timestamp up to which events are replayed, in yyyymmddhhmm format. |
| `webhook_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the webhook to replay events to. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
  created_at?: string | null,
  job_id?: string | null
} | null
```

### validate

`webhooks.validate`

Triggers a CRC check for a given webhook.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.twitter.api.webhooks.validate({ webhook_id: '1460323737035677698' });
```

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `webhook_id` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

| `data` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
